raceinfo_chi.Course: C+3 賽道 - 向後移欄

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W1W1W) Jumped only fairly, tailed-off most of the way, came from well back and made some inroads, but couldn't get into it.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，大部分途程居包尾位置。自遙遙落後的位置略為追前，但未能上前爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W5W) Jumped okay, settled at the rear, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W5W) 出閘尚可，居後列。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Crowded start, raced 2 wide towards rear, there to turn, showed limited response early in straight, no clear run approaching 150M, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 起步時受擠迫，居後列，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初對催策反應平平。趨近一百五十米處時未能望空。其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Soon recovered to just worse than midfield on rail after moderate start, saved ground turning in for home, one-paced.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘普通後瞬即恢復走勢，居中間稍後位置，走內欄。轉直路彎時走內欄節省腳程。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W) Blundered shortly after the start, sat towards rear, never a threat (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W) 起步後不久失蹄，居後列。從未能構成威脅。(見競賽事件報告。)

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W4W) Shifted out abruptly at start, trapped wide in midfield, hung out after passing 700M, dropped to rear on turn, weakened early in straight, unacceptable performance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W4W) 起步時急促向外斜跑，居中間位置，走外疊。跑過七百米處後外閃。直路彎墮居後列。直路初轉弱。表現難以接受。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W2W) Settled behind midfield on the rail, closed off nicely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W2W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。末段衝刺良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail without cover, ridden top of home straight, dropped away quickly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄，沒有遮擋。直路初受催策。最後二百米迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W2W) Sat just behind the leaders 2 wide, limited response in the Straight.
(Lame in right front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 居領先馬匹稍後位置，走第二疊。直路上對催策反應平平。
（右前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Tracked leading pair, ridden to give chase 300m out, no extra final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 跟隨領先兩駒。三百米處在催策下展開追趕。最後一百五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (1W1W1W2W) Mid-field, good headway from 300m out, stayed on well closing stages, unable to reach winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(1W1W1W2W) 居中間位置。自三百米處起以佳勢上前。末段保持佳勢，但未能追及頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced at tail, 10 lengths back in the middle stages, still 7 to 8 lengths back turning in, made some headway in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 自大外檔出閘，留居包尾位置。中段落後十個馬位。入直路時仍落後七至八個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Slow to begin, recovered to race in midfield along the fence, lacked the finishing kick to challenge leaders, only held ground final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 起步緩慢，其後恢復走勢，居中間位置，走內欄。未能加速以挑戰領先馬匹。最後二百米僅能保持位置。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Sat behind the leaders, made no ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 居領先馬匹之後。末段未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W1W1W) Dropped out from wide draw, good headway final bend against rail to save ground, ran on well in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W1W1W) 自外檔出閘後墮後。直路彎追前甚多，走內欄節省腳程。直路上以佳勢上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W1W1W) Slightly slow out, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, angled out early in straight, made some progress in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘稍慢，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段向外移出。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W3W3W) Held up in rear, tight for room when headway amongst horses over 100m out, unable to get on terms with leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W3W3W) 留居後列。一百米處在馬匹之間追前之際受緊迫，未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W3W3W4W) Wide in mid-field, forward move 500m out, unable to sustain, weakened home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W3W3W4W) 居中間位置，走外疊。五百米處上前，其後無以為繼，直路上轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W3W4W) Mid-field, headway out wide final bend, chased leaders 200m out, flattened out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W3W4W) 居中間位置。直路彎上前，走外疊。二百米處追趕領先馬匹。末段洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W3W3W2W) Raced in last pair, still plenty to do final bend, stayed on into mid-field, no threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W3W3W2W) 居最後兩位之內。直路彎仍落後甚遠。保持走勢，進佔中間位置。未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Sluggish start and lost ground, still in last place top of home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 出閘緩慢，失地。直路初仍居包尾位置。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Bumped leaving stalls, tracked leaders, well placed into home straight, quickened early in home straight to lead 250m out, headed by winner 100m out, hung out final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘時發生碰撞，跟隨領先馬匹。入直路時居好位。直路早段加速，二百五十米處取得領先。一百米處被頭馬超越。最後一百米外閃。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (3W3W) Three wide in rear of mid-field with cover, travelled smoothly into home straight, ran on well but no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。入直路時走勢暢順。以佳勢追前，但不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Settled behind midfield on the rail, held up in the Straight, stayed on once in the clear.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。直路上受困。望空後保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Dropped out from wide draw, pushed along widest into home straight, ran on strongly final 200m, beaten only narrowly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 自外檔出閘後墮後。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。最後二百米走勢強勁，僅以短距離之差落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W3W) Settled behind midfield, gave ground inside150M
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居中間之後位置。一百五十米處墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Settled on pace on the rail, nothing extra in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居前列，走內欄。直路上再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W4W) Taken back from gate 10. raced 3 wide with cover behind midfield, very wide turning in, made some progress in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W4W) 自第十檔出閘，留居中間之後位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。入直路時走大外疊。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W1W) Shifted in and bumped at start, held up last, pushed along 500m out, stayed on but never going pace to get competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W1W) 起步時向內斜跑，發生碰撞，留居尾列。五百米處受推策。末段保持走勢，但從未能加速以爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W2W) Away with them, raced better than midfield on the inside, 2-1/2L back turning in, kept on evenly in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W2W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間之前位置，走內疊。入直路時落後兩個半馬位。直路上保持穩勢。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W1W) Bumped shortly after start, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground throughout, showed limited response early in straight, weakened gradually final 100M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 起步後不久碰撞對手，居中間之後位置，走內疊。沿途走內疊節省腳程。直路早段對催策反應平平。最後一百米逐漸轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W2W2W) Shared the lead, weakened over the concluding stages, finished off only fairly (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W2W2W) 並排領先。末段轉弱。衝刺僅屬一般。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (2W2W2W3W) Mid-field, stayed on under pressure, snatched third on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(2W2W2W3W) 居中間位置。在催策下保持走勢。過終點時跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (1W1W1W1W) Towards rear, improved between rivals to challenge 150m out, stayed on and not beaten far.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(1W1W1W1W) 居後列。在對手之間上前，一百五十米處展開挑戰。保持走勢，所負不遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W2W) Mid-field, looking to improve when short of room 300m out to 200m out, unable to quicken once clear, lost ground final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W2W) 居中間位置。三百米處至二百米處之間在空位不足下嘗試推進，但望空後未能加速。最後五十米失地。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (4W2W2W2W2W3W) Sat on pace 2 wide, unable to quicken 500m out, nothing extra in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(4W2W2W2W2W3W) 居前列，走第二疊。五百米處未能加速，直路上再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W1W) Began well from gate 1, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept on evenly in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W2W) Sat towards rear, minor progress made in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W2W) 居後列。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Not hurried on jumping from draw 1, settled in second half of the field, ran on only fairly in the straight. No threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 自第一檔出閘，未受催策，居後半馬群中。直路上走勢僅屬一般。未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat last, picked off a few weakened rivals.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居包尾位置。末段超越數匹已轉弱的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) From draw 1 given a patient ride in a rearward spot, had some work to do top of the straight, lacked a turn of foot and couldn't launch a serious challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘後居後列，留力候上。直路初仍落後甚遠。未能加速以展開真正挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W) Settled well behind and waited with, saved ground on the inside turning in for home, produced strong late finish between runners inside final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W) 遙居於後，留力候上。轉入直路時走內疊節省腳程。最後二百米在馬匹之間衝刺強勁。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W2W3W) Tracked leaders, ridden along to chase leaders 400m out, briefly hampered 200m out, flattened out final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。四百米處在催策下追趕領先馬匹。二百米處一度受阻礙。最後一百五十米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Tracked pace out wide without cover, improved to press leader 1000m out, challenged leader 500m out, faded final 250m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。一千米處上前追迫領放馬。五百米處挑戰領放馬。最後二百五十米力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W3W2W1W) Moderately away from the widest draw, raced 3 wide better than midfield early, moved closer after passing 1000M, 2nd in the middle stages, 2-1/2L back turning in, peaked on run 200M, weakened final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W3W2W1W) 自大外檔出閘普通，早段居中間之前位置，走第三疊。跑過一千米處後追近，中段居第二位。入直路時落後兩個半馬位。二百米處未能再增速，最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W5W) Settled down in midfield about 4Ls off the pace, switched wide from 700M before giving limited response in the straight. Couldn't sustain run late stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W5W) 居中間位置，落後領放馬約四個馬位。自七百米處起移出外疊。直路上對催策反應有限。末段未能保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Raced keenly, ridden along to lead, gave ground and failed to respond over the concluding stages (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 搶口，在催策下取得領先。末段墮退，對催策毫無反應。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W2W2W3W) Tracked pace, forced three wide final bend, pushed along, every chance until no extra final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W2W2W3W) 跟隨領放馬。直路彎走第三疊。受推策，一度甚具爭勝機會，直至最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W3W) Average to begin, raced 2 wide better than midfield, 3 wide from 600M, challenged the leaders turning in, took the lead approaching 200M, kept on well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W3W) 出閘普通，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。自六百米處起走第三疊。入直路時挑戰領先馬匹。趨近二百米處時取得領先。保持佳勢至終點，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, had to wait for run turning into home straight, clear run 300m out, briefly hampered 100m out, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。三百米處望空。一百米處一度受阻礙，保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (3W3W) Three wide in mid-field with cover, some headway on bend, sustained headway early in home straight to lead 200m out, headed by winner 100m out, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。直路彎略為追前。直路早段持續追前，二百米處取得領先。一百米處被頭馬超越。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Sat towards rear on the rail, traveled smoothly, closed off nicely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 居後列，走內欄，走勢暢順。衝刺良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W3W) Sat in front of midfield, traveled smoothly, made steady ground late (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W3W) 居中間之前位置，走勢暢順。末段穩步上前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Mid division, had to wait for run turning into home straight, short of room 400m out to 100m out, unlucky.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 居中間位置。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。四百米處至一百米處空位不足。際遇欠運。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (1W1W) In rear after crowded at start, had to wait for run top of home straight, switched wide for clear run 100m out, unlucky.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(1W1W) 起步時受擠迫，居後列。直路初須等待空位出現。一百米處移出外疊以望空。敗在欠運。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Held up last, race keenly throughout, pushed along widest into home straight, made up some late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 留居包尾位置。沿途搶口。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(-) (2W2W2W2W) Across from wide draw to press leader, challenged leader final bend, quickened early to lead top of home straight, margin reduced closing stages but always doing enough.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(-)(2W2W2W2W) 自大外檔出閘後切入，追迫領放馬。直路彎挑戰領放馬。直路初加速，取得領先。末段領先距離收窄，但一直保持佳勢，取得勝利。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Crowded at start, rail position in mid-field, ridden along to chase leaders 400m out, did not get best of runs early in home straight, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 起步時受擠迫，居中間位置，走內欄。四百米處受催策以追趕領先馬匹。直路早段未能完全望空。保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(+) (2W2W2W3W) Bumped start and unbalanced, raced 2 wide better than midfield, commenced move 400M, finished off well to take 2nd without threatening the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(+)(2W2W2W3W) 起步時被碰撞，失去平衡。居中間之前位置，走第二疊。四百米處開始上前。末段衝刺良佳，跑獲亞軍，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Made contact shortly after start, raced 2 wide behind midfield, 5 lengths back turning in, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 起步後不久發生觸碰。居中間之後位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後五個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W4W) Raced rear, switched out at the Turn, limited response when placed under pressure (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W4W) 居後列。直路彎向外移出。對催策反應平平。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Began only fairly, raced 2 wide in midfield, similar position on turn, not enough room early in straight, showed limited response thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間位置，走第二疊。直路彎居相若位置。直路早段空位不足，其後對催策反應平平。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Out with rest, raced slightly behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept to inside after straightening and made some progress.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間稍後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。入直路後保持走內疊，略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (2W2W2W4W) Bumped on jumping, raced slightly behind midfield on the outside, 4 lengths or so back turning in, made good progress in straight to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(2W2W2W4W) 躍出時發生碰撞，居中間稍後位置，走外疊。入直路時落後約四個馬位。直路上追前甚多，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Rail position in rear of mid-field, ridden along from 550m out, short of room final 250m, unable to be ridden out to finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。自五百五十米處起受催策。最後二百五十米空位不足，未能被力策至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Began only fairly, taken back to race towards rear on the inside, moved a bit closer in the middle stages, kept to inside after straightening and made some progress.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，留居後列，走內疊。中段略為追近。入直路後固守內疊，略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Raced in rear after bumped leaving stalls, pushed along wide into home straight, stayed on but never going pace to get competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 出閘時發生碰撞，其後居後列。入直路時受推策，走外疊。保持走勢，但從未能加速以爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W5W) Sat behind midfield, was taken wider near the 900M, switched out entering the Straight, closed off fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W5W) 居中間之後位置。接近九百米處時被帶出較外疊。入直路時向外移出。末段衝刺一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Lifted front feet on jumping and away tardily, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, unable to obtain clear run in straight, eased final 100M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 躍出時一對前腳並舉，出閘緩慢，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上未能望空。最後一百米收慢。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Ridden along from stalls to track leaders, challenged and every chance from 300m out, ran on well but headed by winner close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 出閘後受催策以跟隨領先馬匹。自三百米處起展開挑戰，一度甚具爭勝機會。以佳勢上前，但接近終點時被頭馬超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W1W) Jumped only fairly, taken back to race behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, no clear run early in straight, made no progress thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，留居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初未能望空。其後毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W4W) Bumped out of stalls, waited with towards rear, under pressure from 800m out, lacked pace to challenge, eased once well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W4W) 出閘時發生碰撞，居後列，留力候上。自八百米處起受催策。速度不足以展開挑戰。遙遙落後時隨即收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W2W3W) Bumped shortly after start, sent forward to race in 2nd early, allowed rival to cross near 800M, 4 lengths back on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W2W3W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，早段受催策上前居第二位。接近八百米處時讓對手過頭。直路彎落後四個馬位。直路早段未能再增速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W3W3W) Moderately away, raced slightly behind midfield on the outside, moved closer after passing 1050M, 2 lengths back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened inside final furlong. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W3W3W) 出閘普通，居中間稍後位置，走外疊。跑過一千零五十米處後追近，入直路時落後兩個馬位。直路早段未能再增速，最後二百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W2W3W) Settled in mid-field, taken widest final bend, no extra final 150m and gave ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居中間位置。直路彎被帶出最外疊。最後一百五十米再無餘力及墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Dropped out from widest draw, held up last, under pressure 400m out, passed a few tiring rivals.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自大外檔出閘後墮後，留居包尾位置。四百米處受催策。末段超越數匹漸呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W4W) Sat towards the rear 2 wide, never involved.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W4W) 居後列，走第二疊。從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W2W) Tracked leaders against rail, well placed into home straight, challenged and every chance from 300m out, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。入直路時居好位。自三百米處起展開挑戰，已獲機會盡展所長。末段在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W4W) Settled at rear, traveled smoothly, made up ground in the straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W4W) 居後列，走勢暢順。直路上追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Shifted out and bumped leaving stalls, waited with in rear, effort 400m out, not beaten far.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘時向外斜跑，與對手互相碰撞，居後列，留力候上。四百米處發力。所負不遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W2W) Dropped out from widest draw, still in last place top of home straight, switched for clear run 250m out, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W2W) 自大外檔出閘後墮居包尾位置。直路初仍居包尾位置。二百五十米處轉換跑線以望空。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W3W4W) Jumped with them, raced in midfield on the outside, 3 lengths or so back turning in, showed limited response early in straight, weakened gradually final 100M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W3W4W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，走外疊。入直路時落後約三個馬位。直路初對催策反應平平，最後一百米逐漸轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W2W3W) Bumped shortly after start, raced in midfield on the inside, angled out after passing 450M, 3-1/2L back turning in, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W2W3W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，居中間位置，走內疊。跑過四百五十米處後向外移出。入直路時落後三個半馬位。末段衝刺平穩。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W4W5W) Began only fairly, raced at rear on the outside, still well back on turn, failed to make any progress in straight, finished tailed out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W4W5W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列，走外疊。直路彎仍遙居於後。直路上毫無進展。大敗而回。

raceinfo_chi.Course: C+3 賽道 - 向後移欄

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(+) (1W1W1W) Began moderately settling in midfield in 7th on rail, obtained a clear passage 200M out but could only produce modest impression without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(+)(1W1W1W) 出閘普通，居中間位置第七位，走內欄。二百米處望空，但末段僅能略為追前，未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W4W) Soon taken back to last few from a wide barrier, went wide onto home bend and the widest into straight, made no further impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W4W) 自外檔出閘後瞬即留居最後數位之內。開始轉直路彎時走外疊。入直路時走最外疊。其後再無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (3W3W3W) Jumped with them, raced 2 wide towards rear, 3 wide after passing 700M, 5 to 6 lengths back on turn, very wide into straight, finished off very strongly to be nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(3W3W3W) 與對手同步躍出，居後列，走第二疊。跑過七百米處後走第三疊。直路彎落後五至六個馬位。入直路時走大外疊。末段衝刺凌厲，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (3W3W5W) Settled in midfield mainly 3-wide with cover, commenced move on top of home bend swinging widest into straight, ran on under pressure inside final 200M to be nearest at finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(3W3W5W) 大多居中間位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。直路彎早段開始上前，入直路時移出最外疊。最後二百米在催策下追前。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W) Sat towards the rear 2 wide, stayed on strongly, just missed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W) 居後列，走第二疊。末段保持強勁走勢，僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W) Made contact shortly after start, taken back to race at rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, passed some tired runners in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W) 起步後不久發生觸碰，留居包尾位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上超越數匹已呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W1W3W) Shortly after the start was tight for galloping room and was then ridden conservatively, responded well under reminders in the home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W1W3W) 起步後不久受緊迫，繼而留後。直路上對催策反應良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Out in line, raced 2 wide better than midfield, there to turn, finished off well to make frame, just beaten by a neck.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。衝刺良佳，取得第四名，僅以一馬頸位之差落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W3W) Crowded at start, settled mainly in midfield, ran on steadily on straight without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W3W) 起步時受擠迫，大多居中間位置。直路上穩步上前，未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W) Box seat, switched inside to challenge leaders top of home straight, unable to pick up for pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W) 居包廂位置。直路初向內移入以挑戰領先馬匹。末段受催策，但未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W2W2W) Pressed leader, quickened early to lead turning into home straight, headed by winner and weakened close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W2W2W) 追迫領放馬。轉入直路時率先加速，取得領先。接近終點時被頭馬超越，轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W) Tracked leader, under pressure to challenge leader 400m out, stayed on well but no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W) 跟隨領放馬。四百米處在催策下挑戰領放馬。末段保持佳勢，但不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W2W) Began well from gate 1, took the early lead, headed 950M, 2nd in the middle stages, hard ridden from 200M, retook the lead 150M, kept on well but unable to hold off the winner late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W2W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，早段取得領先。九百五十米處被超越，中段居第二位。自二百米處起受力策，一百五十米處再次取得領先。保持佳勢，但末段不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (6W1W1W) Involved in early battle for lead, led outright after 450m, responded to pressure from 300m out, challenged 100m out, winner too strong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(6W1W1W) 早段爭奪領先，跑了四百五十米後單騎領放。自三百米處起對催策交出反應。一百米處受挑戰。未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W2W) Dropped out from wide draw, held up last, switched wide for clear run 200m out, ran on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W2W) 自外檔出閘後墮後，留居包尾位置。二百米處移出外疊以望空。走勢良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Slow; (1W1W) Jumped well from draw 10 and was obliged to take up the lead to avoid being caught wide, lay out in the Home Straight proving difficult to ride out, had no more to offer 200M.
Jockey dropped whip 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
慢步速;(1W1W) 自第十檔出閘迅速，須領放以免走外疊。直路上外閃，難以被力策。二百米處再無餘力。
騎師於一百米處跌掉馬鞭。
runnerrecords.incident_chi: 騎師於一百米處跌掉馬鞭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W5W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced at rear on the outside, very wide turning in, made some headway in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W5W) 自大外檔出閘後留居後列，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Tracked leaders, ridden 300m out, no extra final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。三百米處受催策。最後一百五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Shifted out and bumped leaving stalls, rear of mid-field towards centre of course, effort 400m out, made up some late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;出閘時向外斜跑，與對手互相觸碰，居中間之後位置，靠近跑道中央競跑。四百米處發力。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Behind early after slow start, in mid-division by halfway, short of room when trying to improve 350m out, stayed on once clear final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘緩慢，早段居後列。半程前居中間位置。三百五十米處在嘗試推進之際空位不足。最後二百米望空後隨即保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; Moderately away, positioned a length behind the leader, hard ridden from 400M, peaked 200M, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;出閘普通，落後領放馬一個馬位。自四百米處起受力策。二百米處未能再增速，其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Soon taken back from a wide barrier, trailed the field to home straight, made short-lived effort past well-beaten horses at about the 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘後瞬即留後。直路前尾隨馬群。約二百米處一度發力，超越數匹已洩氣潰敗的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; Commenced well, taken back to race behind midfield on the stands' side, passed some tired runners final 400M. (See Racing Incidents.)
Lost left front plate.
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;出閘迅速。留居中間之後位置，靠近外欄競跑。最後四百米超越數匹已呈疲態的對手。（見競賽事件報告。）
失去左前蹄的蹄鐵。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Sat handy 2 wide, never a threat. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 居前列，走第二疊。從未能構成威脅。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W1W) Sat behind midfield, traveled greenly, minor ground made.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W1W) 居中間之後位置。走勢稚嫩。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W1W) Sat rear, held up between the 200M to 150M, minor progress made in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W1W) 居後列。二百米處至一百五十米處之間受困。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W4W) Sat off midfield 3 wide, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W2W) Settled in front of midfield, held up until the 200M, closed off okay. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W2W) 居中間之前位置。受困直至二百米處。末段衝刺尚可。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Dropped out from widest draw, travelled smoothly into home straight, ran on well final 200m, no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W) 自最外檔出閘後墮後。入直路時走勢暢順。最後二百米以佳勢上前，不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Patiently ridden from high draw, keen, stayed on late, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 自最外檔出閘，留力候上。搶口。末段保持走勢。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W3W) Broke well but soon taken back to last and waited with while travelling keenly, did not find much room between runners until running on too late inside the 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W3W) 出閘迅速，但瞬即留居包尾位置，留力候上，搶口。在馬匹之間空位不足，一百米處追前，但為時已晚。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W3W) Settled midfield, raced wide, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W3W) 居中間位置，走外疊。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W) Began well from gate 12, taken back to race towards rear on the outside, very wide turning in, made very good progress in straight to take 2nd, nearest finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W) 自第十二檔出閘迅速，留居後列，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊。直路上追前甚多，跑獲亞軍。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (5W2W3W) Held up last, still in last pair top of home straight, passed a few tiring rivals late on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(5W2W3W) 留居包尾位置。直路初仍居最後兩位之內。末段超越數匹已呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W2W) Keen and pressed leader, one of three that raced clear to halfway, weakened 200m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 搶口，追迫領放馬。為半程前拋離馬群的三駒之一。二百米處轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W2W4W) Dropped out from wide draw, held up last, pushed along widest into home straight, outpaced and left behind.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W2W4W) 自外檔出閘後墮後，留居包尾位置。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。末段未能跟上步速，被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W2W2W) In rear after awkward start, ridden along from 550m out, wide into home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W2W2W) 起步笨拙，其後居後列。自五百五十米處起受催策。入直路時走外疊。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Bumped shortly after start, raced at tail, 8 lengths back turning in, made good progress until no clear run in the closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 起步後不久被碰撞，居包尾位置。入直路時落後八個馬位。追前甚多，直至末段未能望空。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W4W) Sat behind midfield, never involved.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W4W) 居中間之後位置。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Mustered no early speed and settled last, made up some steady ground when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 早段缺乏前速，居尾列。在催策下穩步上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Jumped with them, raced better than midfield on the inside, 2 lengths or so back, saved ground on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間之前位置，落後約兩個馬位，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初未能再增速，其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) In rear after awkward start, dropped to last place 600m out, outpaced and left behind final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘笨拙，居後列。六百米處墮後至包尾位置。最後三百米未能跟上步速，被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W2W) Rail position in mid-field, keen middle stages, unable to secure clear run until 200m out, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W2W) 居中間位置，走內欄。中段搶口。未能望空直至二百米處。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W2W3W) Sat towards the rear 2 wide, unable to make up ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W2W3W) 居後列，走第二疊。未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W2W) Rail position in mid-field, had to wait for run turning into home straight, unable to secure clear run until 150m out, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W2W) 居中間位置，走內欄。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。未能望空直至一百五十米處。末段保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Sat at the rear, never involved.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居後列。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W3W) Taken back from a wide draw, never in contention. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W3W) 自外檔出閘後留後。從未參與競逐。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W3W) Raced in touch with leaders, travelled smoothly into home straight, ran on well to edge ahead final 50m in tight finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹，入直路時走勢暢順。走勢良佳，最後五十米取得領先，險勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W2W) Out with rest, raced in midfield on the outside, 4 to 5 lengths back turning in, closed off well to make frame without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W2W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間位置，走外疊。入直路時落後四至五個馬位。衝刺良佳，取得第四名，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, forced to steady 450m out, unable to pick up for pressure from 300m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。四百五十米處被迫收慢。自三百米處起在催策下未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) Tracked leaders, travelled smoothly and well placed, under pressure 400m out, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)跟隨領先馬匹。走勢暢順，居好位。四百米處受催策，保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W3W) Began awkwardly, raced 3 wide in midfield, there to turn, finished off well but always just held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W3W) 出閘笨拙，居中間位置，走第三疊。直路彎前居相同位置。末段衝刺良佳，但一直稍為落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Slightly slow out, raced 3 wide behind midfield, difficult to settle in the early stages, 3 lengths back turning in, failed to close off in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 出閘稍慢，居中間之後位置，走第三疊。早段難以穩定走勢。入直路時落後三個馬位。直路上衝刺乏力。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W2W3W) Awkward start, settled in mid-field, pushed along wide into home straight, ran on well and lost out only narrowly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W2W3W) 出閘笨拙，居中間位置。入直路時受推策，走外疊。以佳勢上前，僅以短距離之差落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Inconvenienced at start, raced 2 wide behind midfield, 4 to 5 lengths back turning in, one-paced in the run home. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 起步時受妨礙，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後四至五個馬位。末段保持同速。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W2W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced 2 wide towards rear, 6 lengths back turning in, made good progress in straight to take a place without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W2W) 自外檔出閘，留居後列，走第二疊。入直路時落後六個馬位。直路上追前甚多，跑獲季軍，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Away with them, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, made good progress in straight, just beaten by a narrow margin.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上追前甚多。僅以短距離之差落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (5W2W2W) Across from wide draw to press leader, struggled to maintain position on bend, dropped away quickly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(5W2W2W) 自最外檔出閘，切入以追迫領放馬。直路彎難以保持位置。最後二百米迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Moderately away, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept on evenly to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘普通，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。保持穩勢，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Ridden along from stalls to track leaders against rail, well placed into home straight, weakened quickly home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘後受催策，沿欄跟隨領先馬匹。入直路時居好位。直路上迅速轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Pressed forward to reach 2nd making first turn, chased the leaders into home straight holding every chance until finding no extra inside final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 首次轉彎時在催策下上前，居第二位。入直路時追趕領先馬匹。一度甚具爭勝機會，直至五十米處再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (6W3W3W) Tracked pace, raced wide to final bend, improved to hold every chance 150m out, no extra final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(6W3W3W) 跟隨領放馬。直路彎前走外疊。一百五十米處上前，一度甚具爭勝機會。最後五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W2W2W2W) Jumped well from the widest draw, sent forward to race in 2nd, 2 wide, there to turn, peaked on run 350M, weakened early in straight, eased inside final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W2W2W2W) 自大外檔出閘迅速，受催策上前，居第二位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。三百五十米處未能再增速。直路初轉弱。最後二百米收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Jumped well from a wide draw, sent forward to race in 2nd, 2 wide, there to turn, peaked 250M, weakened and eased thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 自外檔出閘迅速，受催策上前，居第二位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。二百五十米處未能再增速，其後轉弱及收慢。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Shifted out at start and made contact, raced 3 wide at rear, 5-1/2L back turning in, taken wide in straight and made little progress.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 起步時向外斜跑，發生觸碰，居後列，走第三疊。入直路時落後五個半馬位。直路上移出外疊，略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Made contact at start, raced slightly better than midfield, 2 to 3 lengths back turning in, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 起步時與對手互相觸碰，居中間稍前位置。入直路時落後兩至三個馬位。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W3W3W) Three wide in mid-field, pushed along wide into home straight, bumped 100m out, unable to recover.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。入直路時受推策，走外疊。一百米處被碰撞，其後未能恢復走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W2W) Settled midfield, no clear run at the early Straight, closed off fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W2W) 居中間位置。直路初未能望空。末段衝刺一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Ridden to soon recover from moderate start to 5th within 3L of pace, drifted over 4L back when tempo increased at about 800M, slightly further back in 6th 500M out, fought on steadily in straight without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘普通，受催策，瞬即恢復走勢，居第五位，落後領放馬不逾三個馬位。約八百米處步速加快時墮退，落後逾四個馬位。五百米處略為墮居第六位。直路上持續力拼，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W) Towards rear on rail, saved ground on the inside turning in for home, just over 4L back into straight, fought on steadily without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W) 居後列，走內欄。轉入直路時走內疊節省腳程。入直路時落後稍逾四個馬位。持續力拼，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (4W3W3W5W) Began only fairly, raced 3 wide with cover behind midfield, 4 lengths back, wider turning in, made no progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(4W3W3W5W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，落後四個馬位，走第三疊，有遮擋。入直路時走較外疊。直路上毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Away with them, raced 2 wide better than midfield, 3 lengths back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後三個馬位。直路早段未能再增速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W4W) Away with them, raced behind midfield on outer, very wide turning in, failed to close off in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W4W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間之後位置，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊。直路上衝刺乏力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Settled in front of midfield 2 wide, one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W1W) Sat handy, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W1W) 居前列。保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W4W) Mid-field, unable to quicken under pressure over 300m out, stayed on, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置。三百米處在催策下未能加速。保持走勢，但速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W3W4W) Sat behind midfield 3 wide, never involved.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W3W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (2W2W) Began awkwardly and lost ground, raced towards rear, 5 lengths or so back turning in, no clear run early in straight, made good progress final 200M to be nearest on line. (See Racing Incidents.)
Blood in mouth.

中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘笨拙，失地，居後列。入直路時落後約五個馬位。直路初未能望空。最後二百米追前甚多。過終點時最為接近。（見競賽事件報告。）
口內有血。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Tracked leaders against far rail, short of room 300m out, clear run 200m out, stayed on but unable to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;跟隨領先馬匹，走外欄。三百米處空位不足。二百米處望空。保持走勢，但未能追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Began only fairly, raced 2 wide in midfield, there to turn, finished off well to take 2nd without threatening the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。衝刺良佳，跑獲亞軍，未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W1W) Began well, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, showed limited response early in straight, steadied near 100M, eased thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W1W) 出閘迅速，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段對催策反應平平。接近一百米處時收慢，其後再次收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Began well, raced better than midfield on the outside, 2 to 3 lengths back turning in, closed off well to take a place without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走外疊。入直路時落後兩至三個馬位。衝刺良佳，跑獲季軍，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped awkwardly and lost ground, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, made no progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘笨拙及失地，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上毫無進展。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W1W) Moderately away, sent forward to take the lead, led by 3/4L turning in, kept on well early in straight, peaked and headed 100M, weakened gradually thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W1W) 出閘普通，受催策上前取得領先。入直路時領先四分三個馬位。直路初保持佳勢。一百米處未能再增速，被超越，其後逐漸轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Dragged to the rear from a wide draw, made up good ground but no clear racing room in the last 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自外檔出閘後墮居後列。追前甚多，但最後一百米空位不足。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W3W) Settled handy, raced wide, weakened notably inside 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W3W) 居前列，走外疊。最後二百米顯著轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W2W) Sat midfield on the rail, never in contention.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W2W) 居中間位置，走內欄。從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Bumped start, raced at rear on the inside, last turning in, failed to make any progress in straight, unacceptable performance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 起步時發生碰撞，居後列，走內疊。轉入直路時居包尾位置。直路上毫無進展。表現難以接受。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Bumped exiting stalls, waited with towards rear, dropped to last place top of home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘時被碰撞，居後列，留力候上。直路初墮居包尾位置。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W1W2W) Held up last, still in last place top of home straight, switched inside for clear run 200m out, never going pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W1W2W) 留居包尾位置。直路初仍居包尾位置。二百米處移入內疊以望空。從未能加速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W3W4W) Sat midfield 3 wide with cover, pressed the button 500m out, one-paced to the wire eventually.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W3W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。五百米處發力上前。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W3W) Sat midfield 2 wide, improved from the 700M, kept on strongly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W3W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。自七百米處起推進上前。末段保持勁勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (1W1W1W1W) Began well from gate 1, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, took the lead 200M, kept on very well to the line, won by 2Ls. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(1W1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。二百米處取得領先，保持甚佳走勢至終點，以兩個馬位之先勝出賽事。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W3W2W) Sat last, made some minor late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W3W2W) 居包尾位置。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W2W) Jumped nicely from draw 3, allowed to find his feet early stages and settled down in midfield, stayed on mildly final 400M to claim 4th near line without threatening top three.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W2W) 自第三檔出閘良佳，早段獲許順其自然地競跑，居中間位置。最後四百米保持一般走勢，接近終點時進佔第四位，但未能威脅三甲馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W5W) Settled wide in midfield dropping to last few rounding home bend, widest runner into straight, made no impression under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W5W) 居中間位置，走外疊。轉直路彎時墮居最後數位。入直路時走最外疊。在催策下毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W) Settled worse than midfield, checked and lost its running near the 250M, not much found thereafter (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W) 居中間之後位置。接近二百五十米處時勒避，失去跑線，其後無甚餘力。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Taken back from the wide gate, ran on strongly late once a clear run was secured 200m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自大外檔出閘後留後。二百米處望空後瞬即以勁勢追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W3W3W) Dropped out from wide draw, had to wait for run turning into home straight, clear run 300m out, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W3W3W) 自外檔出閘後墮後。入直路時須等待空位出現。三百米處望空。保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W1W) Sat worse than midfield on the rail, traveled okay, held up at the straight, finished off fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。走勢尚可。直路上受困。衝刺一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W2W3W5W) Waited with towards rear, pushed along widest into home straight, stayed on well but no threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W2W3W5W) 居後列，留力候上。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。保持佳勢，但未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Sat midfield on the rail, saved ground, ran on okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。沿途走內欄節省腳程。末段走勢尚可。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W3W3W) Waited with towards rear, commenced move out wide 950m out, pushed along wide into home straight, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W3W3W) 居後列，留力候上。九百五十米處移出外疊開始發力。入直路時受推策，走外疊。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W3W) Settled behind midfield, one pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W3W) 居中間之後位置。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W2W) Waited with towards rear, a bit keen, crowded final turn, clear 300m out, stayed on but never a threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W2W) 居後列，留力候上，略為搶口。直路彎受擠迫。三百米處望空。保持走勢，但從未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W3W) Out with rest, raced 3 wide slightly better than midfield, crowded approaching 1400M, 2 wide in the middle stages, inconvenienced by the weakened horse near 450M, wide into straight, made no progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W3W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間稍前位置，走第三疊。趨近千四米處時受擠迫。中段走第二疊。接近四百五十米處時受轉弱的對手妨礙。入直路時走外疊。直路上毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W1W1W1W) Held up last from wide draw, still plenty to do 300m out, stayed towards rail, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W1W1W1W) 自外檔出閘，留居包尾位置。三百米處仍落後甚遠，保持走內欄。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W1W) Sat handy, slightly weakened passing the 200M, closed off okay (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居前列。跑過二百米處時略為轉弱。末段衝刺尚可。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Bumped out of stalls, waited with in rear, pushed along widest into home straight, unable to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 出閘時發生碰撞，居後列，留力候上。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (4W3W3W5W) From draw 13 unable to slot in, raced 3-wide without cover in midfield throughout, couldn't keep up with rivals passing 250M, weakened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(4W3W3W5W) 自第十三檔出閘後未能切入，沿途居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。跑過二百五十米處時未能跟上對手，轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Began only fairly, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept on evenly in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W1W) Made contact at start, raced behind midfield on the inside, 6 lengths back, same margin back on turn, one-paced in the run home. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 起步時發生觸碰，居中間之後位置，落後六個馬位，走內疊。直路彎落後相同距離。末段保持同速。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, under pressure 400m out, unable to improve position.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。四百米處受催策。未能推進上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W1W) Sat worse than midfield, limited response when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W1W) 居中間之後位置。對催策反應平平。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W2W2W) Waited with in rear, pushed along 400m out, left behind final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 居後列，留力候上。四百米處受推策。最後二百米被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W1W2W) Waited with towards rear, shuffled back after halfway, angled wide over 200m out, stayed on, unable to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W1W2W) 居後列，留力候上。半程後墮後。二百米處移出外疊。保持走勢，未能追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Settled rear, traveled okay, made steady ground late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居後列，走勢不俗。末段以穩勢追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (2W2W2W3W) Waited with, under pressure in rear turning into home straight, strong run on wide outside final 150m, led close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(2W2W2W3W) 留力候上。轉入直路時居後列，受催策。最後一百五十米在外疊走勢強勁。接近終點時取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W1W) Rear of mid-field, headway up rail from over 200m, stayed on, tight for room close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間之後位置。自二百米處起沿欄追前。保持走勢，接近終點時受緊迫。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W3W) Jumped only fairly, recovered to race in mid-division 5Ls off the pace, placed under pressure from 500M but only battled in the straight. Never a threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W3W) 出閘僅屬一般。恢復走勢，居中間位置，落後領放馬五個馬位。自五百米處起受催策，但直路上僅能勉力而為。從未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) Raced in rear after awkward start, switched wide for clear run 300m out, stayed on but never going pace to get competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 出閘笨拙，其後居後列。三百米處移出外疊以望空。保持走勢，但從未能加速以爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W) Crowded start, raced 2 wide behind midfield, 5 lengths back, same margin back on turn, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W) 起步時受擠迫，居中間之後位置，落後五個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎落後相同距離。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Sat behind midfield on the rail, angled out in the Straight, closed off nicely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。直路上向外移出。衝刺良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W1W1W3W) Waited with in rear, pushed along 700m out and a bit detached in last place, late headway but never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W1W1W3W) 居後列，留力候上。七百米處受推策，居包尾位置，稍被拋離。末段追前，但從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W4W) Sat in the last few, soon unable to keep up with the field 500m out, failed to run on in the straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W4W) 居最後數位之內。五百米處瞬即未能跟上馬群。直路上未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W) Sat towards rear, always rear, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W) 沿途居後列。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W4W) Raced 3 wide no cover off midfield, weakened in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路上轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (2W2W3W4W) Settled midfield, traveled comfortably, switched out rounding the Turn, closed off nicely (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(2W2W3W4W) 居中間位置，走勢暢順。轉直路彎時向外移出。末段衝刺良佳。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W2W) Held up from wide draw, pushed along 500m out, stayed on final 150m, unable to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W2W) 自外檔出閘，留後。五百米處受推策。最後一百五十米保持走勢，但未能追近領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W6W) Dropped in from wide draw, ridden to try and make ground wide on bend, stayed on late, never a threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W6W) 自外檔出閘後移入內疊。直路彎在催策下嘗試推進，沿外疊追前。末段保持走勢。從未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(+) (1W1W) Moderately away, sent forward to take the lead, travelled comfortably in the middle stages, kept on very well in straight, won by a length.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(+)(1W1W) 出閘普通，受催策上前領放。中段走勢暢順。直路上保持甚佳走勢，以一個馬位之先勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(-) (2W3W) Jumped well, took the early lead, headed 1350M, 2nd in the middle stages, 3 wide turning in, kept on well in straight but always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(-)(2W3W) 出閘迅速，早段取得領先。一千三百五十米處被超越。中段居第二位。入直路時走第三疊。直路上保持佳勢，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (1W1W1W1W) Began well from gate 9, sent forward to take the lead, led by 3/4L turning in, peaked and headed 200M, kept on evenly to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(1W1W1W1W) 自第九檔出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先四分三個馬位。二百米處未能再增速，被超越。末段保持穩勢，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Pushed along to be racing closely behind leaders, couldn't sustain run passing 350M, weakened towards the finish. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 受推策，緊隨領先馬匹。跑過三百五十米處時後勁不繼。末段轉弱。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(+) (1W1W1W1W) Jumped well, sent forward to take the lead, enjoyed the easy lead to turn, peaked and headed 200M, stayed on evenly to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(+)(1W1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。直路彎前輕鬆領放。二百米處未能再增速及被超越。末段保持穩勢，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W) Chased leader after jumping from draw 13, briefly led early straight but soon couldn't keep up with pursuing rivals, faded to finish 6th.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W) 自第十三檔躍出後追趕領放馬。直路早段一度領先，但瞬即未能抗衡緊追的對手。力竭，取得第六名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Soon led from a poor draw, gradually shifted across for rails run over 1200M out, led until joined early in home straight, unable to sustain effort inside final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘，瞬即領放。千二米處逐漸切入內欄。領先至直路初被追及。最後一百米無以為繼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Raced 3 back on the fence, hit the gap strongly in the straight, dived late at the winner but missed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 落後三個馬位，走內欄。直路上以勁勢取位上前。末段與領放馬拼鬥，但僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(-) (2W5W) Sat behind mid, traveled fairly well, made good progress from 250M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(-)(2W5W) 居中間之後位置。走勢不俗。自二百五十米處起追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W1W4W4W) Taken back to race at tail, 6 lengths or so back turning in, taken wide in straight and made very good progress to be nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W1W4W4W) 留居包尾位置。入直路時落後約六個馬位。直路上移出外疊，追前甚多，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W2W) Jumped only fairly, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, showed limited response early in straight, no clear run near 150M, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段對催策反應平平。接近一百五十米處時未能望空，保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (4W4W3W2W2W1W) Ridden hard to sit handy, raced wide in the early stages until near the 1000M, gave ground notably from the Back Straight (Unacceptable Performance, Must BT).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(4W4W3W2W2W1W) 在力策下居前列。早段走外疊直至接近一千米處。自對面直路起顯著墮退。（表現難以接受。必須試閘及格。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W3W) Mid-field, struggling to hold position final bend, dropped away.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居中間位置。直路彎難以保持位置。墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W4W5W) Forced wider on the track early stages and shuffled back to last 8Ls or so off the leader, made up several places out wide 800m out, soon tired out early in the straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W4W5W) 早段被迫走較外疊，墮居包尾位置，落後領放馬約八個馬位。八百米處追前數位，走外疊。直路初瞬即力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) Sat last, made some late headway.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 居包尾位置。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W3W) Sat behind midfield on the rail, stayed on only fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W3W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。末段僅保持一般走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W5W) Very slowly away losing considerable ground, trailed the field most of the way and the widest into straight, never seen with a chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W5W) 出閘十分緩慢，失地甚多，大部分途程尾隨馬群。入直路時走最外疊。從未看似有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Towards rear, pushed along when checked briefly 500m out, struggling and left behind final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居後列。五百米處受推策，一度勒避。最後三百米掙扎上前及被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W2W2W) Held up last, still in last pair top of home straight, lacked pace to challenge, never involved.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 留居包尾位置。直路初仍居最後兩位之內。欠缺速度以展開挑戰。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W4W) Began only fairly, ended up racing near last, had some work to do 400M but responded only fairly to pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W4W) 出閘僅屬一般，居接近包尾位置。四百米處落後頗遠，但對催策反應僅屬一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Soon taken back from a wide barrier, trailed the field from about 1300M out, made modest progress past well-beaten horses in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 自最外檔出閘，瞬即留後。自約千三米處起尾隨馬群。直路上略為追前，超越數匹已洩氣潰敗的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Bumped start, raced slightly better than midfield, 2 wide, dropped to midfield on turn, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 起步時被碰撞，居中間稍前位置，走第二疊。直路彎墮居中間位置。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W3W) Raced wide no cover in mid-division, took time to muster in the straight, made ground final 200M without posing a serious threat to first few.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置，走外疊，沒有遮擋。直路上加速需時。最後二百米追前，但未能真正威脅首數名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Caught 3 wide no cover off pace, weakened in the Straight. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居領先馬匹之後，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路上轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W) Broke well from a wide barrier settling in midfield between runners, came under pressure to challenge upon straightening but did not find much room until inside the 200M, quickened well to snatch 2nd final strides.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W) 自外檔出閘迅速，居中間位置，在馬匹之間競跑。入直路時在催策下展開挑戰，但空位不足直至二百米處。以佳勢加速，最後數步跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W) Across from wide draw and raced outside of leader, took narrow lead 300m out, headed 200m out and no extra.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W) 自大外檔出閘後切入，居領放馬外側。三百米處以短距離領先。二百米處被超越，再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W3W) Jumped awkwardly and lost ground, raced in midfield on the outside, no cover for the majority of the race, peaked early in straight, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W3W) 出閘笨拙及失地，居中間位置，走外疊。大部分途程沒有遮擋。直路初未能再增速。其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Dropped in from wide draw, struggling in rear when checked 350m out, well held after.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自外檔出閘，向內移入。在後列掙扎上前，三百五十米處勒避，其後落後頗遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W3W) Mustered no early pace and sat at the tail of the field, peeled wide turning for home, rushed home late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W3W) 早段未能加速，居後列。入直路時移出外疊。末段衝刺強勁。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W3W) Taken back on jumping, settled at the rear 10Ls back, maintained his spot to the bend, still miles back top of the straight and was unable to make any impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W3W) 出閘後留居後列，落後十個馬位。直路彎前保持位置。直路初仍落後甚遠。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W2W3W) Sat towards rear, traveled okay, one pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W2W3W) 居後列，走勢尚可。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Shifted out and bumped at start, rail position in rear of mid-field, driven along 800m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 起步時向外斜跑，與對手互相碰撞，居中間之後位置，走內欄。八百米處受催策。未能增速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (1W1W1W1W) Began well from gate 1, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, finished off strongly to score by a neck.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(1W1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。衝刺強勁，以一馬頸位之先勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced 2 wide towards rear, 4 lengths or so back turning in, angled out early in straight, cleared 300M, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 自大外檔出閘後留居後列，走第二疊。入直路時落後約四個馬位。直路早段向外移出。三百米處望空。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (2W3W2W3W) Taken back from gate 8, raced at tail, still 9 lengths back on turn, very wide into straight, made good progress in the run home to take a place, no threat to the first two.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(2W3W2W3W) 自第八檔出閘後留居包尾位置。直路彎仍落後九個馬位。入直路時走大外疊。末段追前甚多，獲得季軍，但未能威脅首兩名馬匹。

raceinfo_chi.Course: C+3 賽道 - 向後移欄

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (2W1W1W) Traveled nicely midfield on the rail, closed off well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(2W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄，走勢良佳。末段衝刺良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W2W) Mid division, pushed along wide into home straight, outpaced and left behind final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W2W) 居中間位置。入直路時受推策，走外疊。最後一百五十米未能跟上步速，被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Crowded shortly after start, held up last, head in air 700m out, switched wide for clear run 250m out, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 起步後不久受擠迫，留居包尾位置。七百米處昂首。二百五十米處移出外疊以望空。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W4W) Dropped out from wide draw, pushed along wide into home straight, unable to improve position.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W4W) 自外檔出閘後墮退。入直路時受推策，走外疊，未能推進。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W2W) Jumped only fairly, settled towards the rear 7Ls back, kept to inside in the straight, closed off well but couldn't be ridden out to the finish final stages when awkwardly placed. Could do better.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列，落後七個馬位。直路上固守內疊。衝刺良佳，但末段處於窘境之際未能被力策至終點。本應可交出更佳表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(-) (5W2W2W) Jumped with them, raced 2 wide better than midfield, 4 lengths or so back turning in, kept on well in straight to make frame without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(-)(5W2W2W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後約四個馬位。直路上保持佳勢，取得第四名，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (2W2W2W) Tracked leaders, pushed along to chase leaders 500m out, ran on well to lead 150m out, headed close home, just failed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(2W2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。五百米處受推策以追趕領先馬匹。以佳勢追前，一百五十米處取得領先。接近終點時被超越，僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (4W4W) Jumped well from a wide draw, raced in midfield on outer, no cover for the majority of the race, peaked early in straight, ran on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(4W4W) 自外檔出閘迅速，居中間位置，走外疊。大部分途程沒有遮擋。直路初未能再增速。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (5W3W4W) Began well from gate 11, trapped wide in midfield, no cover throughout, weakened early in straight when hard run took toll. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(5W3W4W) 自第十一檔出閘迅速，居中間位置，走外疊。沿途沒有遮擋。耗力太多，直路早段轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W2W3W) Sat on pace 2 wide, showed some dash, run peaked final 75M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W2W3W) 居前列，走第二疊。略為加速上前。最後七十五米未能再增速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Across to track leader, ridden along to chase leader 600m out, stayed on steadily but no threat to winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 切入以跟隨領放馬。六百米處受催策，追趕領放馬。保持穩勢，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (4W2W2W) Ridden from the widest draw settling one back in 2nd 850M out, improved to take up running 440M out holding over 1L advantage into straight, kept on well under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(4W2W2W) 自大外檔出閘後受催策。八百五十米處居第二位，落後一個馬位。上前，四百四十米處取得領先。入直路時領先逾一個馬位。末段在催策下保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W2W) Sat on pace, one pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W2W) 居前列。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Sat midfield, traveled fairly, not much impression made (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置。走勢普通。無甚表現。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W1W1W) Sat midfield on the rail, one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W2W) Raced in touch, chased down leaders under pressure over 200m out, stayed on well, beaten little distance in tight finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W2W) 緊隨領先馬匹。二百米處受催策，追趕領先馬匹。保持佳勢，在多駒幾乎齊過終點下所負不遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W1W1W) Settled behind midfield on the rail, made good ground along the inside. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。末段沿內疊追前甚多。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Sat on pace, traveled nicely, was hampered over the concluding stages, closed off okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 居前列，走勢良佳。末段受阻礙。其後衝刺尚可。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W4W) Bumped start, positioned 2 wide, 1-1/2L back, angled out after passing 600M, showed good response early in straight, peaked 200M, ran on evenly to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W4W) 起步時發生碰撞，落後一個半馬位，走第二疊。跑過六百米處後向外移出。直路初對催策反應良佳。二百米處未能再增速。保持穩勢，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W1W1W) Knuckled over at the start, raced better than midfield on the inside, 4 lengths back turning in, showed limited response early in straight, weakened inside final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W1W1W) 起步時俯首前跪，居中間之前位置，走內疊。入直路時落後四個馬位。直路初對催策反應平平。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W4W) Crowded early, raced in mid-field, wide and under pressure turning into home straight, stayed on, unable to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W4W) 早段受擠迫，居中間位置。轉入直路時受催策，走外疊。末段保持走勢，未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Badly crowded at start losing ground, tailed-off most of the way, never a factor.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 起步時嚴重受擠迫及失地。大部分途程居包尾位置。從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Settled wide in rear of midfield, came under pressure rounding home bend, ran on well inside final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走外疊。轉直路彎時受催策。最後一百五十米以佳勢上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Settled in midfield from moderate start some 3L off the pace, drifted slightly further back onto course proper, renewed effort under pressure inside final 200M, ran on steadily to be nearest at finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘普通，居中間位置，落後領放馬約三個馬位。跑離分支直路時略為墮後。最後二百米受催策時再度發力，穩步上前，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Jumped only fairly, ended up racing at the back of the field, failed to make any real progress final 400M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘僅屬一般，居馬群後列。最後四百米無甚進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W) Crowded at start, rail position in mid-field, driven along 600m out, unable to pick up for pressure against rail from 400m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W) 起步時受擠迫，居中間位置，走內欄。六百米處受催策。自四百米處起沿欄在催策下未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Sat at the 2nd half of the field, held ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 居後半馬群中。保持位置。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Moderately away, raced 2 wide behind midfield early, found rail 600M, peaked turning in, weakened early in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘普通，早段居中間之後位置，走第二疊。六百米處移入內欄。轉入直路時未能再加速。直路早段轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W3W) Rear of mid-field, little response to pressure 300m out, well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W3W) 居中間之後位置。三百米處對催策無甚反應，遙遙落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Broke well from the one draw settling just off the pace on rail, remained in 3rd but further away from pacemaker in back straight, within 2L when 2nd turning in for home, soon found no extra.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居領放馬稍後位置，走內欄。對面直路上仍居第三位，但進一步落後領放馬。入直路時居第二位，落後不逾兩個馬位。瞬即再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Jumped only fairly, restrained to race near last, driven along 500M, held up briefly near 200M but never going the pace to challenge leaders. (Jockey - no explanation for the disappointing performance.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，受約束，居接近包尾位置。五百米處受催策。接近二百米處時一度受困，但速度不足以挑戰領先馬匹。（騎師未能就坐騎令人失望的表現提供任何解釋。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W3W) Bumped leaving stalls, settled in mid-field, switched and driven 400m out, ran on well to close on leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W3W) 出閘時發生碰撞，居中間位置。四百米處轉換跑線及受催策。以佳勢上前，追近領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W5W) Sat in front of midfield 2 wide, closed off nicely when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W5W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。末段在催策下衝刺良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (3W2W3W) Crowded early and settled in rear of mid-field, forward move 300m out, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(3W2W3W) 早段受擠迫，居中間之後位置。三百米處上前。末段保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W2W2W) Midfield early stages gradually dropping to 11th 850M out, did not find much room on the inside early after straightening but produced good late impression inside final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W2W2W) 早段居中間位置，逐漸墮後，八百五十米處居第十一位。入直路後在直路早段走內疊時空位不足，但最後一百米追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W2W) Began well from gate 1, raced slightly better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, finished off strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W2W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間稍前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。末段衝刺強勁，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W4W) Settled behind midfield 2 wide, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W2W3W) Held up in last pair, stayed on final 200m, never a threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W2W3W) 留居最後兩位之內。最後二百米保持走勢。從未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W3W) Settled in rear of mid-field, pushed along wide into home straight, ran on well to move into third.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W3W) 居中間之後位置。入直路時受推策，走外疊。以佳勢上前，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W2W3W) Prominent 4-wide before taken one-out-one-back for cover 700M out, came to challenge entering straight but had nothing to give.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W2W3W) 居前列，走第四疊。七百米處居第二疊第二位以取得遮擋。入直路時上前展開挑戰，但再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Taken back to race 2 wide behind midfield, 4 lengths or so back turning in, unable to obtain clear run in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W) 留居中間之後位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後約四個馬位。直路上未能望空。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W) Settled within 3L of pace in 5th on rail, snuck closer turning in for home holding every chance on the inside early in straight until 50M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W) 落後領放馬不逾三個馬位，居第五位，走內欄。轉入直路時追近。直路早段走內疊，一度甚具爭勝機會直至五十米處。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(-) (1W3W) Sat handy on the rail, showed good dash early part of the Straight, hit the front at the 200M, weakened final 75M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(-)(1W3W) 居前列，走內欄。直路早段以佳勢加速上前。二百米處取得領先。最後七十五米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (6W1W1W) Taken back to last from the widest barrier trailing the field to home straight, ran on past well-beaten ones inside final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(6W1W1W) 自大外檔出閘，留居包尾位置。直路前尾隨馬群。最後一百米上前超越已洩氣潰敗的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Settled in front of midfield on the rail, one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 居中間之前位置，走內欄。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W2W) Sat behind midfield, lay in in the early Straight, gave ground inside 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W2W) 居中間之後位置。直路初內閃。一百五十米處墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W3W) Jumped only fairly, given a waiting ride towards the rear, brought wide into straight before running on moderately to the finish. Posed no threat to first three however.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列，留力候上。入直路時移出外疊。保持不俗走勢至終點，但未能對頭三名馬匹構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Jumped on terms and obtained a midfield position 6Ls off the pace, raced keenly in the middle stages, just kept to the task in the run home and failed to trouble leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，落後領放馬六個馬位。中段搶口。末段持續力拼，但未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat in front of midfield on the rail, just one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間之前位置，走內欄。末段在催策下僅能保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) Sat worse than midfield, had difficulty obtaining clear running in the early Straight, failed to respond (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 居中間之後位置。直路早段難以望空。對催策毫無反應。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Began only fairly, given a waiting ride at the rear 6-7Ls back, gave limited response when asked, raced in restricted room final 100M and not ridden out. (Jockey - better suited by stepping back up in distance.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列，落後六至七個馬位，留力候上。對催策反應平平。最後一百米在窄位競跑，未能被力策。（騎師表示，坐騎增程回師較長途程應較合發揮。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W) Held up last, blocked off when going for run 400m out, clear run final 150m, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W) 留居包尾位置。四百米處在試圖取位之際受困。最後一百五十米望空，但未能增速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Dropped out from widest draw, had to wait for run turning into home straight, switched for clear run 300m out, some late gains.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 自大外檔出閘後墮後。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。三百米處轉換跑線以望空。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Waited with in rear, headway halfway out against rail, stayed on for pressure in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 居後列，留力候上。半程時上前，走內欄。直路上在催策下保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W) Close up early before settling over 3L back in 5th early in back straight, further away from lead approaching home bend, kept on steadily without quickening under pressure in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W) 早段緊隨領放馬。其後於對面直路早段居第五位，落後逾三個馬位。趨近直路彎時落後領放馬更遠。直路上保持穩勢，在催策下未能增速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W3W) Settled in mid-field, travelled smoothly into home straight, ran on strongly to lead 150m out, won comfortably.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W3W) 居中間位置。入直路時走勢暢順。以勁勢追前，一百五十米處取得領先。從容取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W2W) Settled just worse than midfield in 8th mainly about 5L off the pace, gained closer to 3L 7th into straight but did not find much room most of the way, made no further impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W2W) 大多居中間稍後的第八位，落後領放馬約五個馬位。入直路時追近至第七位，落後三個馬位，但直路上大部分途程空位不足。未能進一步追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Sat midfield on the rail, one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Moderately away from gate 1, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘普通，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初對催策反應平平。最後一百五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W1W2W) Sat on pace, traveled fairly, weakened over the final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W1W2W) 居前列，走勢一般。最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Tracked leaders, good headway final bend to chase leaders, sustained headway to challenge 300m out, stayed on but no threat to winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。直路彎以佳勢上前，追趕領先馬匹。三百米處持續追前以展開挑戰。保持走勢，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Taken back from high draw and never out of rear, left behind under pressure final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自大外檔出閘後留後，從未超越後列。最後三百米受催策，但被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W) Awkward start, rail position in mid-field, pushed along to chase leaders 400m out, weakened quickly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W) 起步笨拙，居中間位置，走內欄。四百米處受推策以追趕領先馬匹。最後二百米迅速轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, under pressure 400m out, lacked pace to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。四百米處受催策。速度不足以追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Jumped with them, sent forward to take the lead, travelled well to turn, peaked and headed approaching 300M, weakened and eased thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 與對手同步躍出，受催策上前領放。直路彎前走勢良佳。趨近三百米處時未能再增速及被超越，其後轉弱及收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W3W3W) Three wide in mid-field, raced keenly, unable to pick up from pressure from 400m out, lost touch final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，搶口。自四百米處起在催策下未能加速。最後二百米被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W2W) Made contact shortly after start, sent forward to race prominently, 2 wide, 1/4L back turning in, weakened early in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W2W) 起步後不久發生觸碰，受催策上前，居前列，走第二疊。入直路時落後四分一個馬位。直路初轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W) Began well from a wide draw, raced slightly behind midfield on the outside, there to turn, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W) 自最外檔出閘迅速，居中間稍後位置，走外疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初未能再增速。其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Waited with towards rear, dropped to last place into home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居後列，留力候上。入直路時墮居包尾位置。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W3W) Taken back from gate 10, raced 3 wide towards rear, 7 lengths back turning in, failed to make any progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W3W) 自第十檔出閘後留居後列，走第三疊。入直路時落後七個馬位。直路上毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (4W3W4W) Sat 3 wide midfield, not much impression made (See Incident Report).
