runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(4W3W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。無甚表現。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W1W1W) Soon prominent, led outright after 400m, pressed on 300m out, headed 100m out, no extra.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W1W1W) 瞬即居前列位置。過了首四百米後單騎領放。三百米處受追迫。一百米處被超越，末段再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (4W2W2W) Mid division, pushed along wide into home straight, tended to shift right in home straight, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(4W2W2W) 居中間位置。入直路時受推策，走外疊。直路上傾向向內斜跑。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W3W) Tracked pace three wide, no extra final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W3W) 跟隨領放馬，走第三疊。最後一百五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Tracked leader, weakened 300m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領放馬。三百米處轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Raced in rear of mid-field, briefly hampered 800m out, ridden top of home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間之後位置。八百米處一度受阻礙。直路初受催策。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Led early, headed after 500m, remained prominent, weakened final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 早段領放。跑了五百米後被超越。保持居前列。最後二百米轉弱。

raceinfo_chi.Course: C+3 賽道 - 向後移欄

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W4W) Taken back from gate 13, raced behind midfield on the outside, 3 lengths or so back, there to turn, kept on same pace in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W4W) 自第十三檔出閘後留後，居中間之後位置，落後約三個馬位，走外疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W1W) Began fairly before settling in forward of midfield in 6th one-off the rail, commenced move upon straightening and quickened well inside final 200M to assert authority 100M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W1W) 出閘一般，其後居中間之前第六位，走第二疊。入直路後開始上前。最後二百米加速良佳。最後一百米控制大局，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Made contact shortly after start, raced in midfield, nearer to the middle track, hard ridden from 400M but only showed limited response, weakened inside final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;起步後不久發生觸碰，居中間位置，靠近跑道中央競跑。自四百米處起受力策，但反應僅屬平平。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Mid-field, wide off bend, strong finish final 150m, unable to reach winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置。入直路時走外疊。最後一百五十米衝刺強勁，但未能追及頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Sat on pace near the outside rail, ran on okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居前列，靠近外欄競跑。走勢尚可。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Pressed leader, good progress to lead halfway out, pushed along over 300m out, on top from there, ran on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;追迫領放馬。追前甚多，半程時取得領先。三百米處受推策，其後保持領先。末段衝刺良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Settled in mid-field, ridden along 400m out, stayed on well but hung out final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;居中間位置。四百米處受催策。保持佳勢，但最後二百米外閃。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Made contact shortly after start, positioned 1-1/2L behind the leader on the stands' rail, same position in the middle stages, not enough room until 150M, made some progress thereafter to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;起步後不久與他駒互相觸碰，落後領放馬一個半馬位，走外欄。中段居相同位置。空位不足直至一百五十米處。其後略為追前，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Mid division towards centre of course, pushed along halfway out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;居中間位置，靠近跑道中央競跑。半程時受推策，速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Made contact with the right side of its starting gate, raced prominently, difficult to settle in the early stages, made contact 900M, 2 lengths back on turn, weakened early in straight, eased final 150M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 出閘時觸碰閘廂右側，居前列。早段難以穩定走勢。九百米處發生觸碰。直路彎落後兩個馬位。直路早段轉弱，最後一百五十米收慢。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W3W3W) Shifted out at start and made contact, positioned 3 wide, 2 lengths back, there to turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened final 100M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W3W3W) 起步時向外斜跑，與他駒互相觸碰，落後兩個馬位，走第三疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初在催策下反應平平。最後一百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Mid-field, had to wait for run behind leaders 300m out, went clear with winner from 200m, beaten only narrowly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居中間位置。三百米處居領先馬匹之後，須等待空位出現。自二百米處起與頭馬雙雙帶離對手。僅以短距離之差見負。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) In rear after crowded shortly after start, improved into mid-field by 400m out, angled wide home straight, stayed on final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 起步後不久受擠迫，居後列。四百米處進佔中間位置。直路上移出外疊。最後二百米保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Jumped with them, raced better than midfield, 3 wide with no cover, very wide turning in, kept on well in straight to make frame.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間之前位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。入直路時走大外疊。直路上保持佳勢，取得第四名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Raced prominently, weakened 250m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居前列。二百五十米處轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat on pace 2 wide, kept on without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居前列，走第二疊。保持走勢，未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Ridden along to lead, traveled smoothly, had every chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 在催策下領放。走勢暢順，已獲機會盡展所長。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (6W3W4W) Caught wide and without cover midfield, failed to respond (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(6W3W4W) 居中間位置，走外疊，沒有遮擋。對催策毫無反應。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W3W3W) 3-wide in midfield early stages from a wide barrier gradually improving from 900M out to be 1.5L 3rd 700M out remaining 3-wide, joined leaders briefly making final turn but soon weakened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W3W3W) 自外檔出閘，早段居中間位置，走第三疊。自九百米處起逐漸推進。七百米處居第三位，落後一個半馬位，仍走第三疊。轉直路彎時一度追上領先馬匹，但瞬即轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (4W3W3W) Settled midfield 3 wide with cover, one pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(4W3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (4W4W) Out with the line and sat 3-wide behind the leaders on settling, could not muster any sort of challenge in the straight and weakened passing 300M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(4W4W) 與對手同步出閘，居領先馬匹之後，走第三疊。直路上從未能展開挑戰。跑過三百米處時轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W3W) Caught 3 wide behind midfield, nothing extra in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。直路上再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Niggled along in forward of midfield on rail, steadied up in slackened tempo rounding home bend, baulked behind runners after straightening, quickened well inside final 150M to just get up on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 受催策，居中間之前位置，走內欄。轉直路彎步速減慢時收慢。入直路後在馬匹之後受困。最後一百五十米加速良佳。終點線上僅勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W1W) Sat behind midfield on the rail, made no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。毫無表現。

formguide.comments_eng: New Zealand PPG, a 4-year-old gelding, by Super Seth out of the Savabeel mare Ignored. Horses by the same sire include China Win and Victor Supreme. This fellow was given three trials in Hong Kong. In the latest trial, he sat midfield and finished fourth, beaten by 6-1/2Ls, under slight pressure over 1200m on turf in Conghua on October 23. He’s probably not looking like a first-up winner but this race will give us a chance to look at him more closely.
formguide.comments_chi: 「超凡高手」(Super Seth)之後，在港同父馬包括「中國心」及「捷威」等駒，生母出自「小法寶」(Savabeel)。抵港後試閘三次。最近10月23日出試從化草地1200米，早段居中，末段稍騎下跑第四名，落後頭馬6.5個馬位。不似能一出即勝，觀望為宜。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Moderately away from gate 1, positioned 1-1/2L behind the leader on the inside, saved ground throughout, kept on well early in straight, peaked 200M, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘普通，落後領放馬一個半馬位，走內疊。沿途走內疊節省腳程。直路早段保持佳勢。二百米處未能再增速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W1W1W) Sat midfield on the rail, made no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Tracked leader, no extra and lost ground final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 跟隨領放馬。最後一百五十米再無餘力及失地。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (3W1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, challenged up rail from 300m out, strong run to lead 100m out, won cosily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(3W1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。自三百米處起沿欄展開挑戰。走勢強勁，一百米處取得領先。輕鬆取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W3W) Sat last, limited response when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W3W) 居包尾位置。對催策反應平平。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W2W2W) Sat last, made no ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W2W2W) 居尾列。未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Tracked pace, ridden to hold position from 400m out, no extra final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 跟隨領放馬。自四百米處起在催策下保持位置。最後一百五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W2W3W) Sat 2 wide behind the leaders, made minor progress when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W2W3W) 居領先馬匹之後，走第二疊。在催策下略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W2W2W) Across from wide draw to press leader, chased leader into home straight, weakened final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W2W2W) 自外檔出閘後切入，追迫領放馬。入直路時追趕領放馬。最後五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very fast; (4W2W2W) Sat outside the lead, weakened final 300M. (See Incident Report)
(Roarer again.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極快步速;(4W2W2W) 居領放馬外側，最後三百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）
（再次患有喘鳴症。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(+) (1W1W) Began well from gate 1, sent forward to take the early lead, headed near 800M, retook the lead turning in, peaked and headed 250M, weakened gradually final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(+)(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，早段受催策上前，取得領先。接近八百米處時被超越。入直路時重奪領先。二百五十米處未能再增速，被超越。最後一百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Failed to show his usual gate speed and had to settle close to rear, shifted in abruptly across heels to obtain clear room 350m out, stayed on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;未能展現一貫前速，居接近後列位置。三百五十米處急促向內移入，橫越對手後蹄以望空。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Jumped well and led on the rail, headed in the Straight, kept on nicely for 3rd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，沿欄領放。直路上被超越。保持佳勢，取得季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (4W3W3W) Caught 3 wide no cover on pace, nothing extra in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(4W3W3W) 居前列，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路上再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (4W3W2W) Jumped with them, raced behind midfield on the outside, moved a bit closer on turn, finished off very strongly to score by a narrow margin. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(4W3W2W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間之後位置，走外疊。直路彎略為追近。衝刺凌厲，以短距離之先勝出。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (1W1W2W) Tracked pace, improved alongside winner home straight, ran on well final 100m, beaten only narrowly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(1W1W2W) 跟隨領放馬。直路上與頭馬一同上前。最後一百米走勢良佳。僅以短距離落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Raced in touch with leaders, pushed along 500m out to chase leaders, no extra final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 緊隨領先馬匹。五百米處受推策，追趕領先馬匹。最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Mid-field, switched inside 200m out, stayed on well final 100m and nearly got up for second.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 居中間位置。二百米處向內移入。最後一百米保持佳勢，幾乎跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W) Sat outside the lead, gave ground from the 300M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W) 居領放馬外側。自三百米處起墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W3W) Out fast, stranded 3 wide no cover throughout, stuck on gamely despite a tough run.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W3W) 出閘迅速，沿途走第三疊，沒有遮擋。儘管多走腳程，但保持勁勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat in front of midfield, traveled okay on the rail, made good progress inside 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間之前位置，走內欄，走勢尚可。最後二百米追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W2W3W) Sat 2 wide towards rear, slightly held up at the top of the straight, made-up late ground last 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W2W3W) 居後列，走第二疊。直路初略為受困。最後一百米追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, short of room early in home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。直路初空位不足。末段速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Prominent early dropping over 2L back to joint 4th rounding home bend, one-paced in straight in the run to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 早段居前列。轉直路彎時墮後逾兩個馬位，並居第四位。直路上衝刺時保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W3W) Tracked pace, a bit outpaced 500m out, tended to hang right top of home straight, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W3W) 跟隨領放馬。五百米處略為被拋離。直路初傾向內閃。保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to slow; (2W2W1W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced at tail, 7 lengths back turning in, made some progress early in straight, weakened final 100M. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Lame in right front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏慢步速;(2W2W1W) 自大外檔出閘，留居包尾位置。入直路時落後七個馬位。直路初略為追前。最後一百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）
（右前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W2W2W) Raced in touch with leaders, switched for clear run 300m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。三百米處轉換跑線以望空，但速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Jumped well, raced prominently on the inside, 1/2L back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened final furlong. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，居前列，走內疊。入直路時落後半個馬位。直路初未能再加速。最後二百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W1W1W) Checked at start and taken well back, saved ground with rails run throughout, kept on same pace without quickening under pressure in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W1W1W) 起步時勒避，留居遙遙落後的位置。沿途走內欄節省腳程。直路上在催策下保持同速，未能增速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Slowly away, rail position in mid-field, forced to steady on heels 900m out, pushed along into home straight, unable to quicken.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 出閘緩慢，居中間位置，走內欄。九百米處被迫收慢避開他駒的後蹄。入直路時受推策，未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Jumped fairly, settled rear 2 wide, no clear run early in straight, closed off nicely in the final 100M
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列，走第二疊。直路初未能望空。最後一百米衝刺良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Crowded at start, held up in rail, ridden from top of home straight, stayed on but lacked pace to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 起步時受擠迫，沿欄留後。自直路初起受催策，保持走勢，但未能加速以追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W) Away well, sent forward to race prominently, difficult to settle near 900M, positioned 2 wide, 2 lengths back on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened gradually final 250M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前，居前列。接近九百米處時難以穩定走勢。直路彎落後兩個馬位，走第二疊。直路初未能再增速。最後二百五十米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Moderately away, raced 2 wide slightly behind midfield, 4-1/2L back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened final 300M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 出閘普通，居中間稍後位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後四個半馬位。直路初未能再增速。最後三百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Began only fairly from draw 1, chased leaders along the inside fence, soon lost touch with leaders on straightening, weakened rapidly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘僅屬一般，沿欄追趕領先馬匹。入直路時瞬即被領先馬匹拋離。末段迅速轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W3W3W3W) Held up, struggling from top of home straight, well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W3W3W3W) 留後。自直路初起掙扎上前。遙遙落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(+) (2W2W2W) Settled in worse than midfield in 8th, ridden from 800M out and given reminders from 400M out, forced to check and switch for a run over 200M out, finished off the race well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(+)(2W2W2W) 居中間之後第八位。自八百米處起受催策。自四百米處起受鞭策。二百米處被迫勒避及轉換跑線取位。末段衝刺良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (2W4W) Amongst leaders early drifting backward to midfield onto home bend, steadied for a stride 700M out, switched wide for a run entering straight, ran on well to just fail to get up on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(2W4W) 早段居領先馬群中。開始轉直路彎時墮居中間位置。七百米處一度收慢。入直路時移出外疊以取位。以佳勢追前，終點線上僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Made contact at start, taken back to race 2 wide behind midfield, wider turning in, made good progress early in straight, peaked 100M, kept on same pace to the line.
(Lame in right front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 起步時發生觸碰，留居中間之後位置，走第二疊。入直路時走較外疊。直路初追前甚多。一百米處未能再增速。保持同速至終點。
（右前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W4W) Caught 3 wide no cover midfield, ran on nicely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。末段走勢良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Bumped out of stalls, held up last, pushed along widest into home straight, ran on strongly final 200m, just failed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 出閘時發生碰撞，留居包尾位置。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。最後二百米走勢強勁，僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W3W4W) Bumped start, raced 2 wide in midfield, hard ridden after passing 450M, wide into straight, kept on same pace in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W3W4W) 起步時被碰撞，居中間位置，走第二疊。跑過四百五十米處後受力策。入直路時走外疊。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W4W) Bumped shortly after start, waited with towards rear, pushed along widest into home straight, strong run to lead 100m out, won cosily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W4W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，居後列，留力候上。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。衝刺強勁，一百米處取得領先，從容取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Commenced well, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, closed off well to take 2nd without threatening the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。衝刺良佳，跑獲亞軍，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W) Settled in mid-field, under pressure 400m out, short of room 250m out, unable to improve position.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W) 居中間位置。四百米處受催策。二百五十米處空位不足。未能推進。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Made contact shortly after start, taken back to race at rear, 5 to 6 lengths back, same margin back on turn, made some headway in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 起步後不久發生觸碰。留居後列，落後五至六個馬位。直路彎落後相同距離。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Began only fairly, raced 2 wide behind midfield, 4 lengths or so back turning in, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後約四個馬位。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, ridden top of home straight, ran on strongly to lead close home and hold on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路初受催策。其後以勁勢上前，接近終點時取得領先，保住勝果。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Mid division, under pressure 600m out, switched wide for clear run 400m out, short-lived effort 200m out, unable to sustain.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 居中間位置。六百米處受催策。四百米處移出外疊以望空。二百米處一度發力，其後無以為繼。

raceinfo_chi.Course: C+3 賽道 - 向後移欄

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W2W) Mid-field, angled off rail early in home straight, made effort 200m out, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W2W) 居中間位置。直路早段移離內欄。二百米處受催策。保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W2W) Jumped well from gate 1, positioned 2 lengths behind the leader on the inside, commenced move approaching 400M, showed very good response in straight, took the lead 100M, kept on strongly to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W2W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，落後領放馬兩個馬位，走內疊。趨近四百米處時開始上前。直路上對催策反應甚佳。一百米處取得領先。保持勁勢至終點，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W) Stayed close enough to leaders throughout, worked into the race well passing 400M but couldn't muster enough mid-straight and weakened out of contention.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W) 沿途保持緊隨領先馬匹。跑過四百米處時以佳勢上前，但直路中段加速力不足。轉弱，再無爭勝機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W3W) Dipped at start before settling just over 2L back in 4th on rail, angled out 500M out for a run into straight, tightened and lost position 200M out and ran home one-paced.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W3W) 出閘時將頭低俯，其後居第四位，落後稍逾兩個馬位，走內欄。五百米處向外移出，入直路時取得空位。二百米處受緊迫及失位。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Bumped leaving stalls, settled in rear of mid-field, ridden along 600m out, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘時發生碰撞，居中間之後位置。六百米處受催策。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Settled in front of midfield on the rail, switched out in the Straight, ran on nicely, just held on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間之前位置，走內欄。直路上向外移出。末段以佳勢上前，僅保住冠軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Settled in rear of mid-field, struggled to hold position on bend, made up some late ground but never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間之後位置。直路彎難以保持位置。末段略為追前，但從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, hampered shortly after start, challenged up rail from top of home straight, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。起步後不久受阻礙。自直路初起沿欄展開挑戰。保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (1W1W1W1W) Sat towards rear, traveled okay, stayed on to grab 3rd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(1W1W1W1W) 居後列，走勢尚可。保持走勢，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W3W4W) Sat rear, raced keenly in the middle stages and had to be checked, angled out making the Turn, one pace to the line (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W3W4W) 居後列。中段搶口，須勒避。轉直路彎時向外移出。末段保持同速至終點。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W2W3W) Sat towards rear 2 wide, steadied at the early stages, started to make progress rounding Home Turn, ran on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W2W3W) 居後列，走第二疊。早段收慢。轉直路彎時開始推進。以佳勢追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W1W1W) Taken across from wide draw, raced towards rear, stayed on at the one pace under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自外檔出閘後切入內疊，居後列。末段在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (3W3W3W4W) Keen towards rear, forward move out wide into mid-field at halfway, headway 300m out, shifted left briefly 200m out, stayed on well, every chance final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(3W3W3W4W) 居後列，搶口。半程時上前至中間位置，走外疊。三百米處追前。二百米處一度向外斜跑。末段保持佳勢，最後五十米已獲機會盡展所長。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Jumped only fairly, raced 2 wide towards rear, found rail 900M, saved ground on turn, kept on well early in straight, peaked 200M, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列，走第二疊。九百米處移入內欄。直路彎走內欄節省腳程。直路初保持佳勢。二百米處未能再增速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W1W1W) Ridden to lead setting a moderate pace, headed inside the 300M and folded up quickly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 受催策取得領先，以中等步速領放。最後三百米被超越，迅速力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W2W) Tracked leader, under pressure 700m out to chase leader, faded final 200m, forced to steady 150m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 跟隨領放馬。七百米處受催策以追趕領放馬。最後二百米力竭。一百五十米處被迫收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W2W) Tracked leaders, had to wait for run turning into home straight, clear run top of home straight, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。直路初望空，末段在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W1W) Made running, kicked one length clear top of home straight, stayed on well but headed on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 帶頭。直路初加速帶離一個馬位。保持佳勢，但終點線上被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Ridden along to lead, failed to respond under whip (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 受催策，取得領先。對鞭策毫無反應。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W2W1W1W) Across from widest draw to lead, set strong pace, joined and headed 400m out, flattened out final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W2W1W1W) 自最外檔出閘後切入內疊，以快步速領放。四百米處被追上及超越。最後二百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W2W2W2W) Pressed forward from a middle draw eventually joining leader 2-wide on first bend 1200M out, became one-out-one-back in 3th 700M out, ran home one-paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W2W2W2W) 自中檔出閘後受催策上前，千二米處首個彎位追上領放馬，走第二疊。七百米處居第三位，落後一個馬位，走第二疊。直路上在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (3W3W2W2W) Bumped start, raced in 2nd, 1-1/2L back turning in, kept on well in straight to take a place without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(3W3W2W2W) 起步時發生碰撞，居第二位。入直路時落後一個半馬位。直路上保持佳勢，跑入季席，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Ridden along to lead, raced keenly in the early stages, gave ground notably in the Straight (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 在催策下取得領先。早段搶口。直路上顯著墮退。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Worked through to sit just off the leader, pace very fast in the first half, asked for effort 300M but found nothing in a fading run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 在催策下緊隨領放馬，賽事前半程步速甚快。三百米處受催策，但末段力竭，再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W5W) Bumped heavily at start, raced in midfield on the outside, 4 lengths back turning in, one-paced in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W5W) 起步時發生大力碰撞，居中間位置，走外疊。入直路時落後四個馬位。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Bumped start, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, same position on turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened gradually final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 起步時發生碰撞，居第二位，走第二疊。直路彎居相同位置。直路初對催策反應平平。最後一百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Bumped leaving stalls, disputed led, clear leader top of home straight, headed by winner 250m out, weakened final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 出閘時發生碰撞，爭奪領先。直路初領放。二百五十米處被頭馬超越。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W5W) Three wide in mid-field, pushed along widest into home straight, outpaced and left behind final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W5W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。最後二百米未能跟上步速，被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to slow; (1W2W2W2W) Sat on pace, weakened inside 250M.
Substantial blood.
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏慢步速;(1W2W2W2W) 居前列。二百五十米處轉弱。
氣管內有很多血。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Jumped well, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1/2L turning in, peaked and headed 200M, weakened gradually final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先半個馬位。二百米處未能再增速，被超越。最後五十米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Jumped well, sent forward to take the lead, led by 3/4L turning in, kept on very well in straight, won by 2 lengths.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先四分三個馬位。直路上保持甚佳走勢，以兩個馬位之先勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (2W2W2W2W) Jumped with them, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, there to turn, peaked early in straight, weakened final furlong. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 與對手同步躍出，居第二位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路早段未能再增速，最後二百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W2W2W1W) Sat behind the pace 2 wide, kept on strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W2W2W1W) 居領放馬之後，走第二疊。保持強勁走勢，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W3W3W3W) Caught 3 wide with cover off pace, nothing extra in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W3W3W3W) 居領放馬之後，走第三疊，有遮擋。直路上再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (5W4W3W4W) Settled midfield 3 wide with some cover, stayed on well, no threat to the first few.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(5W4W3W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，略有遮擋。保持佳勢，但未能威脅首數名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W5W) Mid-field, made effort wide off final bend, every chance from 200m out, no extra closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W5W) 居中間位置。直路彎發力，走外疊。自二百米處起已獲機會盡展所長，末段再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (2W5W) Waited with towards rear, followed winner through from 400m out, unable to match pace of that rival but stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(2W5W) 居後列，留力候上。自四百米處起跟隨頭馬上前。末段未能跟上頭馬，但保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W1W1W2W) Settled behind midfield on the rail, stayed on nicely for 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W1W1W2W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。末段保持佳勢，取得亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W) Taken back from gate 12, raced 2 wide at rear, 6 lengths or so back turning in, made little progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W) 自第十二檔出閘，留居後列，走第二疊。入直路時落後約六個馬位。直路上略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W2W3W) Waited with towards rear, still travelling smoothly 400m out, effort and headway, flattened out final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W2W3W) 居後列，留力候上。四百米處走勢仍然暢順。其後發力追前。最後一百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W2W) Slow to begin, waited with in rear, didn't get best of runs first half of home straight, stayed on at the one pace.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 出閘緩慢，居後列，留力候上。直路前半段未能完全望空，保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Began well and tracked the pace on outside, kept up with leader early straight and was still in contention passing 200M, run ended final stages and weakened to 6th.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，跟隨領放馬，走外疊。直路初保持跟隨領放馬，跑過二百米處時仍具爭逐機會。末段無以為繼，轉弱，跑獲第六名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W2W2W) Sat behind midfield, limited response when asked (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 居中間之後位置。對催策反應平平。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W2W) Settled towards rear on the rail, little response when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W2W) 居後列，走內欄。受催策時無甚反應。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W1W3W) Shifted in and bumped out of stalls, held up last, still in last place into home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W1W3W) 出閘時向內斜跑及被碰撞，留居包尾位置。入直路時仍居包尾位置。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W2W1W) Slowly away, held up in last pair, under pressure when short of room 150m out, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W2W1W) 出閘緩慢，留居最後兩位之內。一百五十米處在受催策之際空位不足。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, ridden top of home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路初受催策。未能增速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W2W) Settled towards rear on rail, commenced move rounding home bend, switched in for a clear run just inside the 200M, kept on steadily without quickening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W2W) 居後列，走內欄。轉直路彎時開始上前。跑過二百米處後向內移入以望空。末段保持穩勢，未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W3W4W) Dropped out from wide draw, held up last, good headway middle stages, pushed along widest into home straight, ran on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W3W4W) 自外檔出閘後墮後，留居包尾位置。中段追前甚多。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。末段以佳勢上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W2W) Awkward start and lost ground, settled in rear of mid-field, unable to pick up for pressure from 450m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W2W) 起步笨拙及失地，居中間之後位置。自四百五十米處起在催策下未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W3W3W4W) Crowded briefly soon after start, three wide in rear, widest on bend, stayed on final 150m, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W3W3W4W) 起步後不久一度受擠迫，居後列，走第三疊。直路彎走最外疊。最後一百五十米保持走勢。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W1W2W4W) Waited with in rear, under pressure 600m out, pushed along wide into home straight, unable to quicken.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W1W2W4W) 居後列，留力候上。六百米處受催策。入直路時受推策，走外疊。末段未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W2W3W) Held up in last pair, outpaced early in home straight, late gains but never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W2W3W) 留居最後兩位之內。直路初被拋離。末段追前，但從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W2W2W) Commenced well, positioned 3-1/2L behind the leader on the inside, 2 wide from 650M, same margin back turning in, taken wide in straight and finished off strongly to take 2nd, nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W2W2W) 出閘迅速，落後領放馬三個半馬位，走內疊。自六百五十米處起走第二疊。入直路時落後相同距離。直路上移出外疊，末段衝刺強勁，跑獲亞軍，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W3W) Sat towards the rear, made little impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W3W) 居後列。無甚表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Rail position in rear of mid-field, driven top of home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 沿欄居中間之後位置。直路初受催策，速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W1W1W) Across from wide draw to lead, pressed in front, kicked 400m out, headed 100m out, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W1W1W) 自外檔出閘後切入領放。在領放下受追迫。四百米處加速。一百米處被超越。持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(-) (1W1W2W3W) Jumped awkwardly, settled handy, traveled smoothly, kept on well to hold 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(-)(1W1W2W3W) 出閘笨拙，居前列。走勢暢順。末段保持佳勢，保住亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(-) (4W3W2W2W) Settled in front of midfield, strode forward in the middle stages and crossed the lead, ran on evenly (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(-)(4W3W2W2W) 居中間之前位置。中段展步上前，超越領放馬。末段走勢平穩。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W2W2W) Moderately away from the widest draw, raced prominently, 2 wide, there to turn, kept on evenly in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W2W2W) 自大外檔出閘普通，居前列，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路上保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sent forward to lead, kept on strongly to score. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 受催策上前領放。保持強勁走勢，掄元。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W1W) In rear after impeded leaving stalls, dropped to last place 500m out, ran on strongly final 200m to pass plenty of field.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W1W) 出閘時受阻礙，其後居後列。五百米處墮居包尾位置。最後二百米以勁勢追前，超越多駒。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Sent forward to be prominent 3 wide, kept on only fairly. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 受催策上前，居前列，走第三疊。末段僅能保持一般走勢。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W3W4W) Three wide in rear, commenced move out wide 600m out, stayed on well in home straight, promising.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W3W4W) 居後列，走第三疊。六百米處起開始上前，走外疊。直路上保持佳勢。表現不俗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W3W) Shifted out and bumped leaving stalls, waited with in rear, followed runner-up through 700m out, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W3W) 出閘時向外斜跑，被碰撞。居後列，留力候上。七百米處跟隨亞軍馬匹上前。保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W3W) Began well, raced 2 wide in midfield, wider turning in, kept on evenly in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 出閘迅速，居中間位置，走第二疊。入直路時走較外疊。直路上保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W5W) Under pressure to hold a position behind midfield, didn't respond turning for home. (Jockey - failed to travel throughout and was not comfortable on the Yielding track. / No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W5W) 受催策以保持中間之後位置。轉入直路時對催策毫無反應。（騎師表示，坐騎沿途走勢欠順，不適應「黏地」的場地狀況。）（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Settled mainly with 2L of pace in 5th or 4th, ran on under pressure to hit the front narrowly 150M out only to be caught final strides.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 大多居第四或第五位，落後領放馬兩個馬位。受催策上前，一百五十米處以短距離領先。僅於最後數步被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W1W1W1W) Jumped only fairly, sat behind midfield, obtained clear running until near the 250M, closed off fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W1W1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置。接近二百五十米處時望空。衝刺一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W3W3W) Three wide in rear of mid-field, driven 300m out, unable to improve position.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。三百米處受催策。未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W5W) From wide draw dropped back to a rearward position on settling, couldn't keep up passing 400M, weakened and finished tailed out. (Unacceptable Performance. / No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W5W) 自外檔出閘，墮居後列。跑過四百米處時未能跟上，轉弱及包尾大敗而回。（表現難以接受。賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W3W) Tracked pace, weakened over 300m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W3W) 跟隨領放馬。三百米處轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Began well, soon dropped to midfield over 4L off the pace, ran home one-paced.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 起步迅速，瞬即墮居中間位置，落後領放馬逾四個馬位。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(+) (2W2W2W3W) Tracked pace, effort from top of home straight, stayed on under pressure, still gaining on winner at line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(+)(2W2W2W3W) 跟隨領放馬。自直路初起發力。在催策下保持走勢。過終點時仍在追近頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W2W2W) Mid-field, no extra and lost ground final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 居中間位疊。最後一百米再無餘力，失地。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Tracked leader, under pressure 700m out to chase leader, one paced under pressure, flattened out close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領放馬。七百米處受催策以追趕領放馬。在催策下保持同速。接近終點時洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W2W2W2W) Wide early, disputed lead, still every chance 100m out, no extra.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W2W2W2W) 早段走外疊，爭奪領先。一百米處仍甚具爭勝機會，但末段再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W3W3W) Began swiftly and tracked pace, unable to slot in and face the breeze throughout, momentarily struck the front 150m out and boxed on solidly, despite a tough run.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W3W3W) 出閘迅速，跟隨領放馬。未能切入內疊，沿途沒有遮擋。一百五十米處一度取得領先，儘管耗力甚多，仍持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Sat behind the leaders, switched out in the Straight, ran on nicely, run peaked at the 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居領先馬匹之後。直路上向外移出。以佳勢上前。一百米處未能再增速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Began fairly gradually improved to 5th some 3L back on rail, angled out for a run entering home straight, obtained a clear run 250M out but unable to quicken to threaten.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘一般，逐漸推進至第五位，落後約三個馬位，走內欄。進入直路時向外移出取位。二百五十米處望空，但未能加速以構成威脅。

raceinfo_chi.Course: C+3 賽道 - 向後移欄

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Surged forward from pole position and attempted to hold them all out, inconvenienced when being crossed middle stages, hit the front at 100M and had them all wrapped up.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘，迅速上前，嘗試領放。中段在被超越之際受妨礙。一百米處取得領先，穩操勝券。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Broke well from a wide barrier but unable to obtain cover 3-wide despite taken 2L back onto home bend 1000M out, renewed effort to dispute lead 600M out but unable to sustain effort upon straightening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 自外檔出閘迅速，走第三疊，未能取得遮擋。一千米處開始轉直路彎時留後兩個馬位。六百米處重新發力，上前爭奪領先，但入直路時無以為繼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W3W) Sat in front of midfield on the rail, made no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W3W) 居中間之前位置，走內欄。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W) Gradually shifted back early to rear of midfield very wide without cover, ridden slightly closer for 3-wide position with cover home bend, kept on under pressure from over 3L 5th into straight until faded inside final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W) 早段逐漸留居中間之後位置，走大外疊，沒有遮擋。直路彎受催策，略為追近，走第三疊，有遮擋。入直路時居第五位，落後逾三個馬位，在催策下保持走勢，直至最後一百米力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Bumped on jumping, raced better than midfield on the outside, 3 lengths or so back turning in, peaked early in straight, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 躍出時發生碰撞，居中間之前位置，走外疊。入直路時落後約三個馬位。直路早段未能再增速。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Made running, ran on strongly to go clear final 200m despite hanging left, very comprehensive winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 帶頭競跑。儘管外閃，但走勢強勁，最後二百米帶離對手。以壓倒性的優勢勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped well, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1/2L turning in, challenged by rival early in straight, peaked and headed approaching 200M, weakened final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先半個馬位。直路早段受對手挑戰。趨近二百米處時未能再增速及被超越。最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W4W) Sat 3 wide towards rear, lay in in the straight, made some ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W4W) 居後列，走第三疊。直路上內閃。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (4W3W4W) Jumped only fairly, raced at rear on the outside, moved a bit closer on turn, very wide into straight, finished off very strongly to score by a neck.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(4W3W4W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列，走外疊。直路彎略為追近。入直路時走大外疊。衝刺凌厲，以一馬頸位之先勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Moderately away, taken back to race towards rear on the middle track, 6 lengths or so back in the middle stages, one-paced final 400M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘普通。留居後列，在跑道中央競跑。中段落後約六個馬位。最後四百米保持同速。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Tracked leaders towards centre of course, ridden along 400m out, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;跟隨領先馬匹，靠近跑道中央競跑。四百米處受催策。末段在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (2W2W2W) Bumped leaving stalls, settled in mid-field, crowded and lost balance 600m out, checked 350m out, unable to recover, eased once well held.
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(2W2W2W) 出閘時發生碰撞，居中間位置。六百米處受擠迫及失去平衡。三百五十米處勒避，未能恢復走勢，遙遙落後時隨即收慢。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Tracked leaders, rail position throughout, unable to quicken 400m out, no extra final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 緊隨領先馬匹。沿途走內欄。四百米處未能加速。最後二百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W) Crowded at start, waited with in rear, pushed along wide into home straight, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W) 起步時受擠迫，居後列，留力候上。入直路時受推策，走外疊。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Pressed leader early stages, tracked leaders against rail middle stages, well placed into home straight, dropped away final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 早段追迫領放馬。中段沿欄跟隨領先馬匹。入直路時居好位。最後二百米墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W) Settled in mid-field, under pressure 550m out, stayed on but never going pace to challenge leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W) 居中間位置。五百五十米處受催策。保持走勢，但從未能加速以威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W) Ridden along from widest draw to get across, headed top of home straight, stuck to task, weakened final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W) 自最外檔出閘後受催策，切入內疊。直路初被超越。持續力拼。最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W1W) Made running, ridden top of home straight, headed 300m out, flattened out final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W1W) 領放。直路初受催策。三百米處被超越。最後二百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Jumped well, raced 2 wide, a length or so back, there to turn, showed limited response early in straight, bumped near 200M, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，落後約一個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路早段對催策反應平平。接近二百米處時被碰撞，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W4W) Tracked pace out wide without cover, taken wider on bend, gave ground final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W4W) 跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。直路彎移出更外疊。最後三百米墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Obtained a midfield position along the fence, raced keenly when pace steadied after 800M, lacked a finishing response in the straight and never able to challenge leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。過了八百米處後在步速減慢時搶口。直路上在催策下衝刺乏力。從未能挑戰領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W3W) Sat 2 wide on pace, never quickened (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W3W) 居前列，走第二疊。從未能加速。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(+) (3W2W2W) Jumped well from a wide draw, positioned 2 wide, a length or so back, same position on turn, kept on well in straight to take a place without threatening. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(+)(3W2W2W) 自外檔出閘迅速，落後約一個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎居相同位置。直路上保持佳勢，跑獲季軍，但未能構成威脅。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (4W3W4W) Raced wide, started well but soon settled back into mid-field, pushed along 400m out, stayed on well final 200m and not beaten far.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(4W3W4W) 出閘迅速，但瞬即留居中間位置，走外疊。四百米處受推策。最後二百米保持佳勢，所負不遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W4W4W) Raced very wide throughout, towards rear and pushed along top of home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W4W4W) 沿途走大外疊。直路初居後列，受推策。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W2W3W) Raced in touch with leaders, challenged and every chance from 300m out, stayed on but no further impression late on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。自三百米處起展開挑戰，一度甚具爭勝機會。保持走勢，但末段再無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W2W4W) Away well enough, restrained to race in midfield, had 5Ls to make up on leader 400M, ran on steadily to the line for 4th without troubling the easy winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W2W4W) 出閘迅速，受約束，居中間位置。四百米處落後領放馬五個馬位。末段穩步上前，取得第四名，未能威脅輕鬆勝出的頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, unable to secure clear run until final 100m, lacked pace to challenge.
(Lost left front plate.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W) 沿欄跟隨領先馬匹。未能望空直至一百米處。速度不足以展開挑戰。
（失去左前蹄的蹄鐵。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Rail position in mid-field, had to wait for run briefly turning into home straight, effort 200m out, no extra and lost ground final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。轉入直路時一度須等待空位出現。二百米處發力。最後一百米再無餘力及失地。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Began well, raced 2 wide in midfield, there to turn, made some progress early in straight, no extra final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居中間位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路早段略為追前。最後一百五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Began only fairly from gate 1, raced towards rear on the inside, angled out 400M, taken wide in straight and made good progress without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 自第一檔出閘僅屬一般，居後列，走內疊。四百米處向外移出。直路上移出外疊，追前甚多，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (3W2W) Sat midfield 3 wide early, got into 2 wide spot rounding the Home Turn, short of room top of the Straight, closed off reasonably well despite the inference.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(3W2W) 早段居中間位置，走第三疊。轉直路彎時移入第二疊。直路初空位不足。儘管受干擾，但末段衝刺頗佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Mid-field, angled off rail and chased leaders into home straight, responded to pressure to lead closing stages, cosy winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 居中間位置。入直路時移離內欄，追趕領先馬匹。末段對催策交出反應，取得領先。從容取勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Settled in mid-field, travelled smoothly to 500m out, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;居中間位置。五百米處前走勢暢順。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Away with them, raced 3 wide in midfield, 3 lengths back turning in, finished off well to take 2nd, just beaten by a narrow margin.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，走第三疊。入直路時落後三個馬位。末段衝刺良佳，跑獲亞軍，僅以短距離之差落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(+) (1W1W1W) Led on the rail, kept on nicely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(+)(1W1W1W) 沿欄領放。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) With leaders on rail early stages, ceded position for one-back 4th onto home bend, in similar position near the rail into straight, kept on same pace under pressure without quickening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 早段與領先馬匹並跑，走內欄。開始轉直路彎時墮後一個馬位，居第四位。入直路時居相若位置，靠近內欄競跑。末段在催策下保持同速，未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Began well from gate 1, positioned 2 lengths behind the leader on rail, saved ground on turn, showed no response early in straight, weakened final 250M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，落後領放馬兩個馬位，走內欄。直路彎走內欄節省腳程。直路早段對催策毫無反應，最後二百五十米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Across to press leader, under pressure 500m out, stayed on well but no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 切入以追迫領放馬。五百米處受催策。保持佳勢，但未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Broke well from the one draw niggling along early, gradually settled about 2L back in 3rd from over 800M out, obtained a clear run over 200M out but unable to quicken to threaten.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，早段受催策。自八百米處起逐漸居第三位，落後約兩個馬位。二百米處望空，但未能加速以構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Began smartly from gate 12, sent forward to take the lead, travelled well to turn, kept on well in straight but unable to hold off the first two final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自第十二檔出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。直路彎前走勢良佳。直路上保持佳勢，但最後五十米未能抗衡頭兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (4W4W) Caught 3 wide near midfield, weakened in the Straight. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(4W4W) 居接近中間位置，走第三疊。直路上轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W3W) Settled behind midfield, raced tight close to the 100M, failed to respond.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W3W) 居中間之後位置。接近一百米處時緊迫競跑。對催策毫無反應。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Slightly slow out, raced at rear throughout, never a factor.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘稍慢。沿途居後列。從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W5W) Checked leaving stalls, four wide in rear, pushed along widest into home straight, soon well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W5W) 出閘時勒避，居後列，走第四疊。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。瞬即遙遙落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Raced in rear, driven along and outpaced from 700m out, eased once well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居後列。自七百米處起受催策，但未能跟上步速。遙遙落後時隨即收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W3W) Three wide in mid-field without cover, unable to hold position halfway, eased once well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。半程時未能保持位置。遙遙落後時隨即收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Sat on pace, traveled strongly, responded nicely when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 跟隨領放馬。走勢強勁。對催策反應良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Sat box seat, ran on nicely, just weakened final strides.
(Bled.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居包廂位置。末段以佳勢上前，僅在最後數步轉弱。
（流鼻血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Pressed leader, quickened early in home straight to lead, kicked two lengths clear 200m out, tired closing stages and just held on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 追迫領放馬。直路早段加速，取得領先。二百米處加速帶離兩個馬位。末段呈現疲態，僅勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Bumped leaving stalls, tracked leaders, unable to secure clear run until 200m out and hung out, ran on well and beaten only narrowly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘時發生碰撞，跟隨領先馬匹。未能望空直至二百米處，外閃。末段走勢良佳，僅以短距離落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat on pace on the rail, traveled strongly, had every chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居前列，走內欄。走勢強勁。已獲機會盡展所長。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, switched for clear run top of home straight, shifted out and bumped 250m out, stayed on well but no further impression on front two late on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。直路初轉換跑線以望空。二百五十米處向外斜跑，與對手互相碰撞。保持佳勢，但末段未能進一步威脅頭兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Began well, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, there to turn, kept on well early in straight, peaked 200M, weakened gradually final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居第二位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初保持佳勢。二百米處未能再增速。最後一百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W3W) Made contact at start, raced in midfield on the outside, 3 lengths or so back, similar position on turn, finished off very strongly to score by a narrow margin.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W3W) 起步時發生觸碰，居中間位置，落後約三個馬位，走外疊。直路彎居相若位置。末段衝刺凌厲，以短距離之先勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (2W2W3W) Bumped leaving stalls, raced towards rear, switched wide entering home straight and hampered rival, edged left and remained down centre of course, stayed on (finished second, demoted to third).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(2W2W3W) 出閘時被碰撞，居後列。入直路時移出外疊及阻礙對手。其後向外斜跑，留在跑道中央競跑，保持走勢。（第二名過終點，被貶為第三名。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Mid-field, struggling to go pace from halfway, dropped away.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居中間位置。自半程起難以跟上步速。墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W5W) Settled slightly worse than midfield, unable to slot in somewhere from gate 11, drifted backwards and lost position 400M out, failed to run on when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W5W) 自第十一檔出閘後未能切入，居中間稍後位置。四百米處墮後，失位。在催策下未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W2W) Sat at the rear, weakened and gave ground quickly in the Straight. (See Incident Report) (Unacceptable Performance, must trial)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W2W) 居後列。直路上迅速轉弱及墮退。（見競賽事件報告。）（表現難以接受。必須試閘及格。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced at rear on the outside, 6 lengths or so back turning in, made very good progress in straight to be nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 自大外檔出閘，留居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後約六個馬位。直路上追前甚多，接近終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (2W3W) Out with rest, raced prominently, 2 wide, allowed rival to cross near 800M, peaked on turn, weakened early in straight, eased final 100M.
(Bled.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(2W3W) 與對手同步出閘，居前列，走第二疊。接近八百米處時讓對手過頭。直路彎未能再加速。直路早段轉弱。最後一百米收慢。
（流鼻血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (4W2W3W) Well behind from the widest barrier, never seen with a chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(4W2W3W) 自大外檔出閘，遙居於後。從未看似有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Raced in touch, starting to struggle when tight for room 250m out, weakened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;緊隨領先馬匹。二百五十米處受緊迫時開始掙扎上前。轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; Raced in touch with leaders, tight for room and hampered 350m out, unable to secure clear run until 100m out, unlucky.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;緊隨領先馬匹。三百五十米處受緊迫及受阻礙。其後未能望空直至一百米處。跑來欠運。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Moderately away, raced in midfield on the stands' side, made no progress final 400M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘普通，居中間位置，靠近外欄競跑。最後四百米毫無進展。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (2W2W3W) Began only fairly, raced towards rear, blundered near 500M, still well back on turn, passed some tired runners in straight.
Lost right front plate.
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(2W2W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列。接近五百米處時失蹄。直路彎仍遙居於後。直路上超越數匹已呈疲態的對手。
右前蹄鐵脫落。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (3W3W) Three wide in mid-field, good headway on bend to chase leaders, no extra final 100m.
(Blood in mouth.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。直路彎以佳勢上前，追趕領先馬匹。最後一百米再無餘力。
（口內有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W2W) Sat towards the rear 2 wide, made no ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W2W) 居後列，走第二疊。末段未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W) Settled midfield 2 wide, made no ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W1W3W) Crowded start, raced at rear on the inside, angled out after passing 500M, 9 lengths or so back turning in, passed some tired runners in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W1W3W) 起步時受擠迫，居後列，走內疊。跑過五百米處後向外移出。入直路時落後約九個馬位。直路上超越數匹已呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W) Sat midfield 2 wide, never impress.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W) Sat rear, raced rear, made steady ground late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W) 沿途居後列。末段穩步上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Settled better than midfield in 5th to straight some 3L back, kept on steadily without quickening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 直路前居中間之前第五位，落後約三個馬位。保持穩勢，未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Sat in front of midfield 2 wide, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W3W) Travelled in midfield despite ridden along in first 200M, about 4L back in 6th rounding home bend, tight inside runners and baulked for a run early in straight, made no impression inside final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W3W) 儘管首二百米受催策，居中間位置。轉直路彎時居第六位，落後約四個馬位。直路初在對手內側緊迫競跑及受困。最後二百米毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Away well, raced 2 wide in midfield, 3 wide after passing 600M, showed limited response early in straight, weakened final furlong. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 出閘迅速，居中間位置，走第二疊。跑過六百米處後走第三疊。直路初對催策反應平平。最後二百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W4W) Sat in front of midfield 2 wide, closed off okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W4W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。末段衝刺尚可。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Rear of mid-field, had to wait for run early in home straight, angled wider 200m out, stayed on, unable to reach leaders.
(Blood in mouth.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居中間之後位置。直路早段須等待空位出現。二百米處移出較外疊。保持走勢，但未能追上領先馬匹。
（口內有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Shifted out at start, raced behind midfield, 2 wide, hampered near 900M, 5 lengths back on turn, no clear run early in straight, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 起步時向外斜跑，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。接近九百米處時受阻礙。直路彎落後五個馬位。直路早段未能望空。保持穩勢至終點。

raceinfo_chi.Course: C+3 賽道 - 向後移欄

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W) Began well from gate 1, raced in midfield on the inside, 3 lengths or so back, saved ground throughout, showed limited response early in straight, weakened gradually final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間位置，落後約三個馬位，走內疊。沿途走內疊節省腳程。直路初對催策反應平平。最後一百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W3W) Settled in 4th over 3L off the pace 2-wide, fanned out for a run entering home straight, fought on steadily without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W3W) 居第四位，落後領放馬逾三個馬位，走第二疊。入直路時向外移出以望空。持續力拼，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (3W1W1W) Always thereabouts, obtained rails run just inside the 800M and cover in 3rd 650M out, did not find much room until switched out for a run 150M out, fought on steadily without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(3W1W1W) 沿途居前列。就在八百米處移入內欄，六百五十米處居第三位，有遮擋。空位不足，一百五十米處移出外疊取位。穩步上前，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W2W2W) Tracked leaders, bumped 1000m out, ridden along 650m out to chase leaders, flattened out final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。一千米處發生碰撞。六百五十米處在催策下追趕領先馬匹。最後一百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (3W2W2W) Settled in mid-field, crowded 600m out, ridden along 250m out, ran on well but no match for winner, just held second.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(3W2W2W) 居中間位置。六百米處受擠迫。二百五十米處受催策。走勢強勁，但未能抗衡頭馬，僅保住亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (3W1W2W) Began well enough, eased back to sit in mid-division 6Ls back, picked up strongly passing 300M, ran on determinedly and got past leader close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(3W1W2W) 出閘頗佳，收慢留居中間位置，落後六個馬位。跑過三百米處時加速強勁。末段以勁勢上前，接近終點時超越領放馬，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W3W4W) Caught racing wide no cover behind midfield, brought wide for home then closed off strongly to be beaten a head by the long time leader.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W3W4W) 居中間之後位置，走外疊，沒有遮擋。入直路時移至外疊，其後以勁勢衝刺，以一馬頭位之差不敵領先了一段長途程的領放馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (2W2W2W2W) Settled in last few from moderate start, hung out first turn, commenced move approaching final turn 400M out, ran on well to be nearest at finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(2W2W2W2W) 出閘普通，居後列。首個彎位外閃。四百米處趨近直路彎時開始上前。末段以佳勢上前。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W4W) Settled in second half of the field, waited with until passing 400M but lacked a kick in the straight. (Both Trainer and Jockey indicated their horse was not suited to the slow tempo of the race in the middle stages.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W4W) 居後半馬群中。留力候上直至跑過四百米處，但在直路上未能加速。（練馬師及騎師均表示賽事中段的緩慢步速不合此駒發揮。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Taken back to race behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, no clear run until approaching final 100M, kept on well to the line without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 留居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。未能望空直至趨近最後一百米時。保持佳勢至終點，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W4W) Bumped on jumping, raced 2 wide in midfield, angled out 500M, showed some response early in straight, peaked 150M, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W4W) 躍出時發生碰撞，居中間位置，走第二疊。五百米處向外移出。直路早段對催策略有反應。一百五十米處未能再增速，保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (2W2W) Settled in mid-field, keen middle stages, dropped to rear of mid-field on bend, unable to secure clear run until 200m out, strong run to lead on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(2W2W) 居中間位置。中段搶口。直路彎墮居中間之後位置。未能望空直至二百米處。衝刺強勁，終點線上取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Settled 3-wide in rear of midfield from a poor draw, inconvenienced 350M out, ran on dourly under pressure to gain upper hand close to home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 自第九檔出閘，居中間之後位置，走第三疊。三百五十米處受妨礙。末段在催策下持續力拼，接近終點時佔得上風。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W3W) Settled at the rear, switched out top of Straight, stay on well. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W3W) 居尾列。直路初向外移出。保持佳勢。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W3W3W) Three wide in rear of mid-field, good headway middle stages, sustained headway top of home straight to lead 150m out, ran on well to hold on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。中段追前甚多。直路初持續追前，一百五十米處取得領先。末段走勢良佳，保住勝果。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W) Slowly away, outpaced and well held early stages, still plenty to do top of home straight, eye-catching headway from rear final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W) 出閘緩慢，早段未能跟上步速，落後甚遠。直路初仍落後頗遠。最後二百米自後列追前，走勢悅目。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Held up, dropped to last pair into home straight, outpaced and left behind in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 留後。入直路時墮居最後兩位之內。直路上未能跟上步速，被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W2W2W3W) Chased leaders early before sitting back in midfield, held up for clear running 400M to 300M then ran home mildly when asked. Not ridden out late stages when held up again.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W2W2W3W) 早段追趕領先馬匹，其後居中間位置。四百米處至三百米處之間受困而未能望空。直路上受催策時走勢普通。末段在再度受困之際未能被力策。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Taken back to last few from a wide barrier and waited with, saved ground on the inside turning in for home, produced good late impression inside final 250M, did best work late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 自外檔出閘後留居最後數位之內，留力候上。轉入直路時走內疊節省腳程。最後二百五十米追前甚多。末段表現最佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced at rear on the inside, still well back on turn, passed some tired runners in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自大外檔出閘， 留居後列，走內疊。直路彎仍遙居於後。直路上超越一些已呈疲態的對手。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W2W) Taken across from a wide draw, settled near last throughout the event, had some work to do top of straight but couldn't pick up speed when needed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W2W) 自外檔出閘後切入。沿途居接近包尾位置。直路初落後甚遠，但於關鍵時刻未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (4W3W3W4W) Pressed forward from the widest barrier 4-wide behind midfield onto first turn, came under pressure from over 400M out swinging one of the widest into straight, kept on past beaten horses.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(4W3W3W4W) 自大外檔出閘，受催策上前，開始轉首個彎位時居中間之後位置，走第四疊。自四百米處起受催策。入直路時向外移出，為走最外疊的馬匹之一。末段持續超越已洩氣的馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Jumped well and pressed on from a wide draw to lead by 1L on settling, offered little on straightening and was easily accounted for.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自外檔出閘迅速，在催策下領先一個馬位。入直路時再無餘力，其後被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W1W1W) Tracked pace, struggled to maintain position from 600m out, dropped away quickly in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W1W1W) 跟隨領放馬。自六百米處起難以保持位置。直路上迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W2W3W) Three wide in mid-field without cover, dropped to rear middle stages, struggling in home straight, unable to be ridden out to finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W2W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。中段墮居後列。直路上掙扎上前，未能被力策至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Shifted out at start, showed good speed to lead, soon joined by rivals top of home straight, headed by runner-up 200m out, faded final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 起步時向外斜跑，展現甚快前速領放。直路初瞬即被對手追上。二百米處被亞軍馬匹超越。最後一百米力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, moved smoothly into contention 300m out, ran on strongly to lead 150m out, on top from there.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。三百米處順勢上前挑戰。走勢強勁，一百五十米處取得領先。其後保持領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (1W1W1W4W) Shifted out and bumped out of stalls, raced prominently, briefly checked 500m out, twice bumped 350m out to 200m out, stayed on well but headed by winner close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(1W1W1W4W) 出閘時向外斜跑，被碰撞，居前列。五百米處一度勒避。三百五十米處至二百米處之間兩度被碰撞。保持佳勢，但接近終點時被頭馬超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W4W) Waited with towards rear, commenced move out wide 600m out, unable to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W4W) 居後列，留力候上。六百米處開始上前，走外疊。未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Raced in rear of mid-field, dropped to rear 700m out and struggled to hold position, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 居中間之後位置。七百米處墮退至後列，難以保持位置。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W) Bumped shortly after start, taken back to race at rear on the outside, 4 to 5 lengths back turning in, finished off well to make frame without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W) 起步後不久被碰撞，留居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後四至五個馬位。衝刺良佳，取得第四名，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Bumped out of stalls, held up last, still in last place top of home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 出閘時發生碰撞，留居包尾位置。直路初仍居包尾位置。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Rail position in rear of mid-field, angled out 300m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。三百米處向外移出，速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(-) (1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, smooth headway against rail top of home straight, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(-)(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。直路初以暢順走勢上前，走內欄。持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Raced in touch with leaders, checked 900m out, switched for clear run 350m out, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。九百米處勒避。三百五十米處轉換跑線以望空。保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Tracked leaders, under pressure 600m out to chase leaders, flattened out final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。六百米處受催策，追趕領先馬匹。最後二百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Ridden forward from wide draw to race prominently, challenged leader 300m out, gradually got on top and led over 100m out, held on as runner-up closed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 自外檔出閘，受催策上前，居前列。三百米處挑戰領放馬。穩步上前，一百米處取得領先。末段被亞軍馬匹追近，保住勝果。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Raced in touch with leaders against rail, angled out for clear run 300m out, ran on well to close on winner, lost out only narrowly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 緊隨領先馬匹，走內欄。三百米處向外移出以望空。末段以佳勢追近頭馬，僅以短距離之差見負。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W5W) Crowded at start, three wide in rear of mid-field, pushed along wide into home straight, stayed on but never going pace to get competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W5W) 起步時受擠迫，居中間之後位置，走第三疊。入直路時受推策，走外疊。保持走勢，但從未能加速以爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat midfield 2 wide, angled out in the Straight, closed off strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。直路上向外移出。衝刺強勁，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W3W) Waited with towards rear, switched wide but unable to secure clear run until 250m out, ran on well final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居後列，留力候上。其後移出外疊，但未能望空直至二百五十米處。最後二百米走勢良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Sat at the rear on the fence, saved ground, not much clear room in the Straight, not fully tested.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居後列，走內欄。沿途走內欄節省腳程。直路上未能望空，未能全力施為。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W5W) Taken back to race 3 wide behind midfield, moved a bit closer on turn, made good progress early in straight, peaked 100M, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W5W) 留居中間之後位置，走第三疊。直路彎略為追近。直路早段追前頗多。一百米處未能再增速，保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W2W) Away with them, positioned 2 wide, 4 lengths or so back, there to turn, closed off well to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W2W) 與對手同步出閘，落後約四個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。末段衝刺良佳，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Jumped with them, raced slightly better than midfield on the inside, 5 to 6 lengths back turning in, made some progress in straight to take a place, no threat to the first two.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間稍前位置，走內疊。入直路時落後五至六個馬位。直路上略為追前，跑獲季軍，但未能威脅首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W4W) Raced in touch with leaders, pushed along wide into home straight, bumped 450m out, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W4W) 緊隨領先馬匹。入直路時受推策，走外疊。四百五十米處與對手互相碰撞。末段在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W2W2W) Settled at the back from a wide draw and waited with, made up good ground under pressure in home straight though never threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W2W2W) 自外檔出閘後居後列，留力候上。直路上在催策下追前甚多，但從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (2W2W2W4W) In midfield in 7th 2-wide alongside eventual winner, crowded for a stride 550M out, commenced move 400M out and ran on from 6th into straight to be nearest at finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(2W2W2W4W) 居中間第七位，與頭馬並跑，走第二疊。五百五十米處一度受擠迫。四百米處開始上前。入直路時自第六位起追前。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W5W) Made contact at start, raced 3 wide with cover behind midfield, 3 to 4 lengths back turning in, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W5W) 起步時發生觸碰，居中間之後位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。入直路時落後三至四個馬位。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced 2 wide at rear, found rail near 700M, saved ground on turn, made some progress early in straight, no clear run final 200M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 自外檔出閘，留居後列，走第二疊。接近七百米處時移入內欄。直路彎走內欄節省腳程。直路初略為追前。最後二百米未能望空。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) Crowded and forced to steady shortly after start, pushed along to settle in rear of mid-field, checked 900m out, lacked pace.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 起步後不久受擠迫，被迫收慢。受推策，居中間之後位置。九百米處勒避。末段未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Dropped out from widest draw, held up last, detached throughout, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自大外檔出閘後墮後，留居包尾位置。沿途被拋離。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W) Sluggish at start, soon made good headway on rail to rear of midfield in 7th, saved ground turning in for home, one-paced.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W) 起步緩慢，瞬即沿欄追前頗多，居中間之後第七位。轉入直路時走內疊節省腳程。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Hampered 1300M out, settled behind midfield on rail, came under pressure home bend, steadied between runners 250M out, ran home one-paced.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 千三米處受阻礙，居中間之後位置，走內欄。直路彎受催策。二百五十米處在馬匹之間收慢。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Raced in rear after crowded at start, lost balance 1000m out, dropped to last place top of home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 起步時受擠迫，其後居後列。一千米處失去平衡。直路初墮居包尾位置。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Began awkwardly, raced in detached last over 10Ls off the pace, ran past a couple of beaten horses only in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘笨拙，遙居包尾位置，落後領放馬逾十個馬位。末段超越兩匹已洩氣的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W5W) Unable to find cover from draw 6 and raced wide in midfield throughout, weakened away badly turning into straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W5W) 自第六檔出閘，未能取得遮擋。沿途居中間位置，走外疊。轉入直路時嚴重轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Began awkwardly and bumped, raced at rear throughout, never a factor.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;出閘笨拙，碰撞對手。沿途居後列。從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W1W1W1W) Sat towards rear, traveled comfortably, responded nicely inside 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W1W1W1W) 居後列，走勢暢順。最後一百五十米對催策反應良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W1W3W) Held up, good headway from 200m out, stayed on, no threat to winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W1W3W) 留後。自二百米處起追前甚多。末段保持走勢，未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Out in line, raced 2 wide in midfield, there to turn, finished off well to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。末段衝刺良佳，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Taken back from a wide draw, was severely checked in the middle stages, made some steady ground final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 自外檔出閘後留後。中段大力勒避。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W) Sat last on the rail, held up early part of the Straight, ran on nicely once in the clear.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W) 居包尾位置，走內欄。直路早段受困，望空後以佳勢上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W2W2W) Sat towards rear, improved from 400M, closed off nicely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W2W2W) 居後列。自四百米處起推進。衝刺良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Niggled along in rear of midfield in 7th on rail, saved ground on the inside turning in for home, baulked for a run from inside the 200M and could make no impression in the run to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 受催策，居中間之後第七位，走內欄。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。二百米處起受困。末段毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W4W4W) Dropped out from widest draw, held up last, commenced move out wide without cover 900m out, ridden along 400m out, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W4W4W) 自大外檔出閘後墮後，留居包尾位置。九百米處開始移出外疊，沒有遮擋。四百米處受催策。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, challenged by rival final bend, headed early in home straight, dropped away quickly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W1W1W) 展現甚快前速以領放。直路彎受對手挑戰。直路早段被超越。最後二百米迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W2W) Shared early pace from a wide barrier before settling 2-wide in joint or outright 2nd, unable to sustain effort and swamped inside final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 自外檔出閘，早段並排領先，其後並列或單騎居第二位，走第二疊。末段無以為繼，最後一百五十米被後上馬群超越。

runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W1W1W) 起步時向內斜跑及被碰撞，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先半個馬位。直路上保持佳勢，但末段未能抗衡首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Made all, kicked 400m out and soon in command, margin reduced closing stages but always doing enough.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 沿途領放。四百米處加速，瞬即控制大局。末段距離收窄，但保持領放至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W2W2W) Raced prominently, challenged 300m out, led 150m out, in control final 50m and comfortable winner.

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W7W) Jumped awkwardly from a poor draw settling well back, shifted widest at the back into straight, produced good impression early in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W7W) 自第十二檔出閘笨拙，遙居於後。入直路時在馬群後方移出最外疊。直路早段追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (2W2W2W) Settled in mid-field, keen middle stages, had to wait for run turning into home straight, ran on strongly final 300m.
