formguide.comments_eng: Australian PP, a 4-year-old gelding, by Fierce Impact from She's A Danica, a daughter of Sebring. Horses by the same sire include Dance With Us and Shannon Glow. This fellow had two starts for two wins (a 3yo maiden over 1200m and a 3yo+ handicap over 1200m). He was given four trials for three placings in Hong Kong. He made the run and finished second, beaten by 1/2L, under slight pressure over 1200m on turf in Conghua on October 12. In the latest trial, he sat midfield and finished third under slight pressure, beaten by 1-3/4L, over 1200m AWT at Sha Tin on November 17. He looks an interesting debutant and could run well here.
formguide.comments_chi: 「極震撼」(Fierce Impact)之後，在港同父馬包括「聞歌起舞」及「紫荊飛躍」，生母出自「識奔」(Sebring)。來港前在澳洲兩戰全勝，頭馬包括一場1200米三歲從未勝出馬賽，及一場1200米三歲及以上讓賽。抵港後四次試閘三次上名。10月12日出試從化草地1200米，早段領放，末段稍騎下跑第二名，落後頭馬半個馬位。最近11月17日出試田泥1200米，早段居中，末段稍騎下跑第三名，落後頭馬1.75個馬位。初出應可交出良好表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W3W) Jumped cleanly then restrained to race in midfield, driven 400M and ran home well. Held by first 2 closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W3W) 出閘俐落，其後受約束，居中間位置。四百米處受催策，衝刺良佳。末段不敵首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (2W2W3W) Began well amongst leaders, taken one-out-one-back to 3rd 900M out and 3L back in 4th over 500M out, renewed effort 3-wide into straight and hit the front 150M out despite shifting ground under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(2W2W3W) 出閘迅速，居領先馬群中。九百米處佔取第二疊第二位，居第三位。五百米處居第四位，落後三個馬位。入直路時重新發力，走第三疊。一百五十米處在催策下斜跑，但仍取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (5W3W4W) Bumped start, raced 3 wide with cover, 5 to 6 lengths back, very wide turning in, finished off evenly. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Lame in right front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(5W3W4W) 起步時被碰撞，落後五至六個馬位，走第三疊，有遮擋。入直路時走大外疊，末段以穩勢衝刺。（見競賽事件報告。）
（右前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Out in line, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1/4L turning in, peaked and headed 300M, weakened final furlong. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Mucus in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極慢步速;(1W1W) 與對手同步躍出，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先四分一個馬位。三百米處未能再增速及被超越。最後二百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）
（氣管有痰。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Began smartly, raced prominently, 2 wide, a length back turning in, hit the front 250M, kept on well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居前列，走第二疊。入直路時落後一個馬位。二百五十米處取得領先。末段保持佳勢，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(-) (2W1W1W) Away well from draw 2, chased leader in 2nd, responded well to take over near 200M, gave all final stages but was run down close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(-)(2W1W1W) 自第二檔出閘迅速，居第二位，追趕領放馬。對催策反應良佳，接近二百米處時取得領先。末段全力以赴，但接近終點時被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good(+) (3W1W1W) Showed good speed to lead early stages, disputed led middle stages, bumped 350m out, headed by winner 150m out, stuck to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速(+)(3W1W1W) 早段展現甚快前速以領放。中段爭奪領先。三百五十米處發生碰撞。一百五十米處被頭馬超越。持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W) Very wide in prominent 4th in early stages, within striking distance for place chance turning into straight only to be denied a placing final stride.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W) 早段居前列第四位，走大外疊。入直路時有機會爭入位置，僅最後數步未能入位。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Sat 4 from the stands' rail in front of midfield, kept on fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居中間之前位置，走外欄第五疊。保持一般走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to slow; Prominent, strong run to lead 300m out, on top from there, won cosily.
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏慢步速;居前列。走勢強勁，三百米處取得領先。其後保持領先。從容取勝。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; Away well, took narrow lead from 800M, kept on under pressure, headed near 200M and not going the pace of first three late.
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;出閘迅速，自八百米處起以短距離領先，在催策下保持走勢。接近二百米處時被超越，末段加速力不及前三名馬匹。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Sluggish start and bumped exiting stalls, tracked pace, ridden along 400m out, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘緩慢，與對手互相碰撞。跟隨領放馬，四百米處受催策。保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (3W3W) Bumped start, sent forward to race prominently, inconvenienced shortly after passing 1300M, 3 wide in the middle stages, no cover throughout, peaked early in straight, weakened final furlong.
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(3W3W) 起步時發生碰撞，在催策下上前，居前列。跑過千三米處後不久受妨礙，中段走第三疊。沿途沒有遮擋。直路早段未能再增速，最後二百米轉弱。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; Well there and wide without cover, came under pressure to hold place coming onto course proper, dropped out tamely inside final 200M.
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;居好位，在離外欄較遠的一方競跑，沒有遮擋。跑離分支直路時在催策下保持位置。最後二百米力竭墮退。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Commenced well, positioned 1 to 2 lengths behind the leader on the stands' side, hard ridden after passing 300M, showed very good response, took the lead approaching 150M, kept on very well to the line, easily scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘迅速，落後領放馬一至兩個馬位，靠近外欄競跑。跑過三百米處後受力策，反應良佳。趨近一百五十米處時領先。末段保持勁勢，輕鬆勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (5W3W) Bumped out of stalls, raced very wide without cover throughout, some headway on bend, dropped away quickly final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(5W3W) 出閘時發生碰撞。沿途在沒有遮擋下走大外疊。直路彎略為追前。最後三百米迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Never far off in a handy spot towards the center of track, couldn't quicken final 300M and was safely held by leaders. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;居前列，從未遠離領先馬匹，在跑道中央競跑。最後三百米未能加速，一直落後領先馬匹。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Ridden from moderate start from a wide barrier before settling just worse than midfield, found nothing under pressure in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 自外檔出閘普通，受催策，居中間稍後位置。直路上對催策毫無反應。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Taken back from a wide draw and settled near last 6Ls off the pace, gave limited response in the straight. Never threatened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 自大外檔出閘，留居接近包尾位置，落後領放馬六個馬位。直路上對催策反應平平。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (4W3W5W) Caught racing wide without cover in midfield, failed to respond when placed under pressure 350M, eased when final 200M.
(Lame in left front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(4W3W5W) 居中間位置，走外疊，沒有遮擋。三百五十米處對催策毫無反應。最後二百米收慢。
（左前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Jumped fairly, gradually recovered to one-out-one-back in 3rd travelling keenly at times, some 3L back making home bend, made modest headway in straight while shifting ground early on to just fail to reach 2nd on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘一般，逐漸恢復走勢，居第三位，落後一個馬位，走第二疊。不時搶口。轉直路彎時落後約三個馬位。直路早段斜跑，其後在直路上略為上前，僅未能在終點線上進佔亞席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Ridden to take up running over 800M out, led on stands rail until finding no extra 150M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;受催策，八百米處取得領先。沿外欄領放，一百五十米處再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (1W1W1W) Bumped shortly after start, tracked leaders against rail, bumped when switched for clear run 200m out, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(1W1W1W) 起步後不久被碰撞，沿欄跟隨領先馬匹。二百米處在向外移出以望空之際與對手互相碰撞。保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W1W) Soon recovered from moderate start to 9th, saved ground turning in for home, ran on well down the inside of straight to be nearest at finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W1W) 起步普通，瞬即恢復走勢，居第九位。轉入直路時走內疊節省腳程。直路上沿內疊以佳勢追前。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W4W) Three wide in rear of mid-field without cover, wide into home straight, bumped 150m out, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。入直路時走外疊。一百五十米處發生碰撞。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (2W2W) Shifted in at start and bumped, raced 2 wide better than midfield, similar position on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
(Sustained a laceration to the right hind leg.)
runnerrecords.healthissue_eng: (Sustained a laceration to the right hind leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(2W2W) 起步時向內斜跑及被碰撞，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。直路彎居相若位置。直路初未能再增速，其後轉弱。
（右後腿割傷。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Jumped awkwardly, settled behind midfield, made steady ground late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 出閘笨拙。居中間之後位置。末段穩步追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (5W4W3W) Bumped out of stalls, dropped out from wide draw, four wide in rear without cover, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(5W4W3W) 自外檔出閘時與對手互相碰撞，墮後，居後列，走第四疊，沒有遮擋。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W3W4W) Settled in midfield 3-wide and without cover at times in back straight, one of the widest turning in for home, kept on at the same pace without threatening and steadied closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W3W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。對面直路上不時沒有遮擋。轉入直路時為走最外疊馬匹之一。保持同速，未能構成威脅。末段收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (3W3W3W) Made contact at start, positioned 3 wide in midfield, travelled keenly in the early and middle stages, 4 lengths or so back turning in, finished off very strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(3W3W3W) 起步時發生觸碰，居中間位置，走第三疊。早段及中段搶口。入直路時落後約四個馬位。末段衝刺凌厲，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W3W3W) Sat in front of midfield 3 wide, run peak at 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W3W3W) 居中間之前位置，走第三疊。一百米處未能再增速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Away only fairly from the middle of the line, recovered to be midfield one off, held up briefly at the home turn, travelled to the line ok (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 自中檔出閘僅屬一般，其後恢復走勢，居中間位置，走第二疊。直路彎一度受困。末段走勢尚可。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (4W3W3W) Settled in rear 3-wide from the widest barrier, commenced move and wider rounding home bend, finished off the race well inside final 150M, did best work late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(4W3W3W) 自最外檔出閘，居後列，走第三疊。轉直路彎時開始上前，走更外疊。最後一百五十米衝刺良佳。末段表現最佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Raced in touch with leaders, caught in a pocket behind front two against rail when trying to challenge 150m out, switched 100m out, ran on well and still closing at line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹。一百五十米處嘗試沿欄展開挑戰時在頭兩名馬匹之後坐包廂。一百米處轉換跑線。末段以佳勢追前，過終點時仍持續追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W3W4W) Bumped on jumping, raced slightly better than midfield on the outside, 3 lengths back turning in, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W3W4W) 躍出時被碰撞，居中間稍前位置，走外疊。入直路時落後三個馬位。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Mid-field, pushed along 500m out, limited headway, no extra and lost ground final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 居中間位置。五百米處受推策，略為上前。最後二百米再無餘力，失地。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Began well from the rails draw, amongst leaders early before settling one back, drifted further back to some 3L off the pace onto course proper, renewed effort inside final 150M but did not find much room.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;自大外檔出閘迅速，早段居領先馬群中，其後落後一個馬位。跑離分支直路時進一步墮退，落後領放馬約三個馬位。最後一百五十米再度發力，但空位不足。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Settled in midfield, fought on steadily without making any serious challenge in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 居中間位置。直路上持續力拼，但未能真正挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Crowded for room after the start, ended up racing at the back of the field, had some work to do top of the straight, closed off fastest and almost claimed 3rd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 起步後受擠迫，居包尾位置。直路初落後頗遠。末段衝刺最快，幾乎跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Settled in last few, 3-wide rounding home bend and baulked for a run in home straight until barged his way out over 50M out
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居最後數位之內。轉直路彎時走第三疊。直路上受困，直至五十米處取位上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Taken back from gate 12, raced 2 wide at rear, commenced move approaching 350M, very wide turning in, finished off very strongly to make frame, nearest finish. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 自第十二檔出閘，留居後列，走第二疊。趨近三百五十米處時開始上前。入直路時走大外疊。衝刺凌厲，取得第四名。過終點時最為接近。（見競賽事件報告。）
